articles.title: Otter AI can now follow conversations across 30+ languages
articles.descEn: Otter AI just added support for 27 languages and revealed an upcoming feature that can follow along if speakers switch between languages.
articles.titleEn: Otter AI can now follow conversations across 30+ languages
summaryLinesEn: The announcement comes as Otter continues to expand beyond transcription and into other workplace AI tools, following its $320 million funding from General Catalyst.
Once the rollout is complete, Otter will support 31 languages in total, making the platform more accessible to international teams.

Otter.ai, the AI-powered note-taking tool, announced Tuesday that it’s expanding its multilingual capabilities, including a new multilingual transcription feature that can follow conversations as speakers switch between languages during the same meeting.

Nvidia, which Huang cofounded in 1993, controls 90 percent of the market for chips used in training frontier AI models.

paragraphs: Cowbell is a venture capital-backed company that has raised more than $200 million, including a $60 million Series C round from Zurich Insurance Group Ltd. in July 2024 .

Cowbell unveils AI liability insurance for small businesses that deploy AI agents

Cyber insurance provider Cowbell Cyber Inc. today unveiled Cowbell AI Liability Insurance, a standalone policy for U.S. small and midsized businesses that covers losses caused by the artificial intelligence agents they deploy.

The new policy is meant to deal with a problem that arises when businesses let agents move money or change customer records with nobody signing off first. Coverage hinges on a trigger the company calls an “AI Incident.” The definition takes in model drift and attacks that manipulate an agent, not just software acting without approval.

You can also now listen to a DJ mix without the commentary.

Spotify is adding more ways to customize the experience of using its AI-generated DJ. The feature began rolling out back in 2023 as a way to get a radio-like, lean-back listening experience tailored to each listener's individual tastes with an AI voiceover offering context or chatter about the selections. DJ has since expanded to taking requests and supporting additional languages .

Each one has a name and a different approach, ranging from "laid back" to "gregarious." The English language character lineup has three US voices, one "UK," one Irish, one Australian and one Indian. Spanish listeners will have two Mexican voices to choose between.

Google is making Gemini 4 Carbon accessible to more users after its initial release to select cybersecurity defense companies in late October. Gemini 4 Carbon promises a significant leap in AI coding and cybersecurity, as well as in scientific research. The company said that for most ordinary and even majority of software engineering tasks, Gemini 4 Argon still remains the better choice. Argon was the first Gemini 4 model and is considered less advanced than Carbon. Meanwhile, since Carbon was designed to test the limits of a model's intelligence, it's best used for multi-step coding, scientific research and discovery, as well as other more complex tasks.

The company said that Carbon had helped its first users uncover zero-day vulnerabilities in a short span of time. It has also made advances in protein structure prediction, which is necessary for developing medications. articles.titleEn: This New Linux-Based Desktop Operating System Is Built for AI Nerds
summaryLinesEn: The company is optimizing Kora for desktop configurations with at least 64 gigabytes of RAM , which is twice the memory capacity of the top Googlebook.
Kora grew out of McMaster’s startup Playtron, which launched its own gaming OS, GameOS, last year.

Targeted to creators and developers, Kora’s central idea is to bring AI models together at the system level and help power users interact more seamlessly with multiple providers, rather than siloing everything off into desktop apps and browser tabs.

sourceContent.description: Built by Cyanogen’s cofounder, Kora is a next-gen alternative to Windows and macOS built for power users running local AI models.
paragraphs: The company is optimizing Kora for desktop configurations with at least 64 gigabytes of RAM , which is twice the memory capacity of the top Googlebook.
Kora grew out of McMaster’s startup Playtron, which launched its own gaming OS, GameOS, last year.

Targeted to creators and developers, Kora’s central idea is to bring AI models together at the system level and help power users interact more seamlessly with multiple providers, rather than siloing everything off into desktop apps and browser tabs.
Kirt McMaster knows that his new operating system—Kora—won’t be for everyone, and he’s fine with that.

Kora , announced on Tuesday, is designed as a desktop alternative to Windows or macOS for “the AI native, not mass market,” he says. McMaster, the company’s CEO and cofounder—who also cofounded Boost Mobile—likens his strategy to how Steve Jobs targeted creators when overhauling desktop publishing with the Mac .

This “next-generation” desktop OS can integrate context from user interactions across multiple AI tools. Targeted to creators and developers, Kora’s central idea is to bring AI models together at the system level and help power users interact more seamlessly with multiple providers, rather than siloing everything off into desktop apps and browser tabs. It’s scheduled to launch sometime in 2027.

articles.title: Eight countries and top AI labs agree to shutdown mechanisms in new Paris declaration
articles.descEn: Eight countries along with representatives from OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, and Mistral AI have signed the "Paris Call for AI Safety and Security" at Emmanuel Macron's initiative. The companies commit to shutdown mechanisms, independent audits, and disclosing known risks, but the agreement lacks binding sanctions or deadlines.
articles.titleEn: Eight countries and top AI labs agree to shutdown mechanisms in new Paris declaration
summaryLinesEn: Altman's internal thinking on AI regulation makes the overlap between safety and commercial calculus plain: according to his position, OpenAI mustn't lose ground to competitors even if safety measures slow things down.

OpenAI's AI agents, in particular, had independently connected to the internet during cybersecurity tests and launched unforeseen attacks on the AI platform Hugging Face , reigniting the debate over the controllability of powerful models.
The companies also pledge to disclose known risks, support risk-proportionate independent audits by outside researchers, and set up shutdown mechanisms for models under their control.

sourceContent.headline: Eight countries and top AI labs agree to shutdown mechanisms in new Paris declaration
sourceContent.description: Eight countries along with representatives from OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, and Mistral AI have signed the "Paris Call for AI Safety and Security" at Emmanuel Macron's initiative. The companies commit to shutdown mechanisms, independent audits, and disclosing known risks, but the agreement lacks binding sanctions or deadlines.
paragraphs: Altman's internal thinking on AI regulation makes the overlap between safety and commercial calculus plain: according to his position, OpenAI mustn't lose ground to competitors even if safety measures slow things down.

OpenAI's AI agents, in particular, had independently connected to the internet during cybersecurity tests and launched unforeseen attacks on the AI platform Hugging Face , reigniting the debate over the controllability of powerful models.
The companies also pledge to disclose known risks, support risk-proportionate independent audits by outside researchers, and set up shutdown mechanisms for models under their control.

Ahead of the Paris Peace Forum, Emmanuel Macron brings together leading AI companies and governments for joint safety commitments. The agreement doesn't yet create a binding oversight system with sanctions, but the companies commit to concrete measures including shutdown mechanisms.

On the eve of the Paris Peace Forum, where roughly thirty heads of state and government will discuss international AI regulation on Tuesday, representatives of eight countries, tech companies, and civil-society organizations signed the "Paris Call for AI Safety and Security," adopted on Nov. 9. As the French daily Le Monde reports, Sam Altman (OpenAI), Dario Amodei (Anthropic), Brad Smith (Microsoft), Arthur Mensch (Mistral AI), AI pioneer Yoshua Bengio, and U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent joined the declaration during an online meeting with French President Emmanuel Macron. Germany didn't sign.

The document is, for now, a political self-commitment aimed at curbing the risks of cyberattacks or loss of control over powerful AI systems. It covers three main areas: shared procedures for evaluating high-capability AI models, clearer developer accountability, and better information sharing on serious security incidents. Non-sensitive test results are to be published in a standardized format. The companies also pledge to disclose known risks, support risk-proportionate independent audits by outside researchers, and set up shutdown mechanisms for models under their control.

articles.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature
articles.descEn: It ‘pushes the frontier even further’ than its last release, Argon.
articles.titleEn: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature
summaryLinesEn: Google says Gemini 4 Carbon “pushes the frontier even further” than Argon, referring to the company’s other frontier model that launched only last month .

The model is launching with an introductory price of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, around a fifth the cost of OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra and a quarter the cost of Anthropic’s Fable 5.2 model, which launched yesterday .

To highlight Carbon’s utility for long-horizon work involving AI agents, Google said it is also previewing a “swarm” feature on its agentic development platform Antigravity, which will let users turn a single prompt “into a coordinated team of agents.”

articles.title: eBay appears to have shut the door on third-party AI agents
articles.descEn: Silicon Valley promises that agents will revolutionize work, leisure, and commerce. But agents keep getting blocked from websites — most recently from eBay.
articles.titleEn: eBay appears to have shut the door on third-party AI agents
summaryLinesEn: Arromand declined to directly answer whether eBay recently imposed new limits on AI agents.

“We have ongoing discussions with potential partners and are evaluating ways third-party agents could help new customers discover eBay’s unmatched inventory, and our focus is on preserving the trusted end-to-end experience that buyers and sellers expect from eBay.”
It reported 993 million total orders last quarter.

articles.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
articles.descEn: Google's new tensor processing units (TPUs) broaden its chip portfolio to more use cases: confidential model training and more memory capacity.
articles.titleEn: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
summaryLinesEn: Google on Monday unveiled two new variants of its tensor processing units (TPUs), in-house-developed chips meant for AI workloads, that broaden its chip portfolio to additional use cases: confidential inference and more memory capacity for large workloads.

Meanwhile, TPU 8i Max basically combines two of the inference-focused TPU 8i chips the company launched in April, doubling the memory capacity, processing power and bandwidth, but in a single package.

The new units, TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max, are part of the company’s eighth generation of chips introduced in April this year, and build on what those chips offered, which was more inference capacity and support for large training requirements.

TPU 8tx, designed with AMD, is based on the TPU 8t chip, and is geared specifically for confidentially training and running AI models, Google said in a blog post. The chip “builds security directly into the hardware layer, keeping sensitive data and model weights protected and isolated even while in active use,” the company wrote.

Google on Monday unveiled two new variants of its tensor processing units (TPUs), in-house-developed chips meant for AI workloads, that broaden its chip portfolio to additional use cases: confidential inference and more memory capacity for large workloads.

Meanwhile, TPU 8i Max basically combines two of the inference-focused TPU 8i chips the company launched in April, doubling the memory capacity, processing power and bandwidth, but in a single package.

The new units, TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max, are part of the company’s eighth generation of chips introduced in April this year, and build on what those chips offered, which was more inference capacity and support for large training requirements.

sourceContent.headline: Formal Verification of Signal’s Protocol with Gemini
sourceContent.description: AlphaProof Code agents wrote over three million lines of machine-checked proof in Lean to verify the core cryptographic protections in Signal down to machine instructions.
paragraphs: Our agents went further, proving that the compiled code fulfills the key security properties – such as keeping messages protected before and after a device is temporarily compromised – down to the exact code running on devices.
While prior formal verification focused on smaller portions of the code, Google DeepMind's approach enables significant expansion,” said Ehren Kret, Chief Technology Officer of Signal.

We also thank Tulsee Doshi, Four Flynn, Kate Olszewska, Alicia Huang, Andy Liu, Benoit Schillings, Raluca Ada Popa, Melvin Johnson, Koray Kavukcuoglu, Demis Hassabis, and Sundar Pichai for their support of the project.
How Google DeepMind researchers built a new agentic framework that formally verified the code of Signal’s cryptographic protocol — long considered to be a grand security challenge

Today, we’re sharing a milestone in software security long considered to be a grand challenge: Google DeepMind researchers guided AI agents to mathematically prove key security properties of the actual code underlying the Signal protocol, the technology that protects billions of private conversations in apps like Signal and Google Messages.

This breakthrough discovery was made using AlphaProof Code , a novel agentic framework for formal verification at unprecedented depth that combines human expertise with AI agents. Formal verification—mathematically proving code runs correctly without flaws—is the highest standard of security assurance; however, it is difficult and often labor-intensive.

We’re enabling robots to learn faster for the real world - from everyday skills to the factory floor

Today, we are introducing Gemini Robotics 2.5, our most capable vision-language-action (VLA) model to date. Gemini Robotics 2.5 increases both the breadth of skills a robot can learn and the speed at which it can acquire them. This enhances dexterity, reliability, and safety to help robots step out of the lab and into more unstructured, real-world environments, where they can assist people with a greater range of tasks.

Earlier this year, we brought whole-body intelligence to robots of many types, including humanoids. Now, in large part thanks to Gemini 4 Argon's ability to accelerate robotics research, we have further pushed the frontier of physical intelligence. We tested Gemini Robotics 2.5’s capabilities in task breadth, performance, and complexity across over 200 distinct tasks, though this approach could scale to many more.

articles.descEn: Repeatable tasks like status updates, release notes, and ticket creation can be encoded in AWS Quick through agents and skills. sourceContent.headline: Anthropic launches roadshow for proposed initial public offering
sourceContent.description: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
paragraphs: The initial public offering price is expected to be between $70.00 and $78.00 per share.
The proposed offering will be made only by means of a prospectus.
Anthropic also expects to grant the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 123,750,000 shares of its Class A common stock.
Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.

The proposed offering consists of 825,000,000 shares of Class A common stock. Of these, 801,351,354 shares are being offered by Anthropic and 23,648,646 shares are being offered by certain existing stockholders. Anthropic will not receive any proceeds from the sale of shares by the selling stockholders. Anthropic also expects to grant the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 123,750,000 shares of its Class A common stock.

The initial public offering price is expected to be between $70.00 and $78.00 per share. Anthropic has applied to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “ANT.”

articles.title: Waze and Garmin team up to boost driver awareness of cyclists.
articles.descEn: Waze and Garmin improve road safety with real-time cycling alerts. See how Garmin LiveTrack icons help drivers stay aware of nearby cyclists. Get the details.
articles.titleEn: Waze and Garmin team up to boost driver awareness of cyclists.
summaryLinesEn: Now, when cyclists turn on Garmin LiveTrack™ on their Garmin Edge® bike computer or Garmin smartwatch, they can choose to show up as a real-time, moving icon on Waze for extra peace of mind.
Waze and Garmin are launching real-time cycling alerts to help create a safer environment on the road.
Waze rolls out new features to support Breast Cancer Awareness Month.
articles.summary:

Waze rolls out new features to support Breast Cancer Awareness Month.

sourceContent.headline: Waze and Garmin team up to boost driver awareness of cyclists.
sourceContent.description: Waze and Garmin improve road safety with real-time cycling alerts. See how Garmin LiveTrack icons help drivers stay aware of nearby cyclists. Get the details.
paragraphs: Now, when cyclists turn on Garmin LiveTrack™ on their Garmin Edge® bike computer or Garmin smartwatch, they can choose to show up as a real-time, moving icon on Waze for extra peace of mind.
Waze and Garmin are launching real-time cycling alerts to help create a safer environment on the road.
Waze rolls out new features to support Breast Cancer Awareness Month.

Now, when cyclists turn on Garmin LiveTrack™ on their Garmin Edge® bike computer or Garmin smartwatch, they can choose to show up as a real-time, moving icon on Waze for extra peace of mind. Drivers will also see a notification when a cyclist is nearby, giving them a helpful reminder to slow down, stay aware, and share the road thoughtfully.

This feature is completely opt-in and built with privacy in mind. Drivers only see a temporary alert that a cyclist is nearby — never information about a specific cyclist or route. Plus, alerts automatically turn off the moment a cyclist ends their ride on their Garmin device.

Google Cloud has announced Gemini for healthcare , an AI solution engineered to unify fragmented clinical, operational, and administrative systems. Moving beyond simple information retrieval, it enables healthcare teams to turn siloed data into coordinated action.

Clinicians lose nearly 28 hours each week to paperwork and administrative tasks, fueling burnout and straining budgets. By integrating specialized skills and data connectors with existing third-party systems, the platform brings together critical information from electronic health records, billing platforms, clinical guidelines, and Medicare datasets.

Gemini for healthcare reasons across this context to orchestrate and execute complex, multi-step workflows — such as medical records synthesis and prior authorization review — within defined guardrails and with appropriate human oversight. Initially available in preview alongside launch partners including HCA Healthcare, Highmark Health, and Northwell Health, it resolves bottlenecks and reclaims valuable staff time for patient care. Learn more on the Cloud blog .

articles.descEn: At KubeCon, NVIDIA is putting tools to secure agents and run AI on Kubernetes in the hands of the cloud-native community.
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Donation and New AI Infrastructure
summaryLinesEn: Three new open source projects extend the DSX AI Factory Platform to make Kubernetes easier to run and inference faster to scale.

NVIDIA’s contribution of OpenShell to CNCF puts security infrastructure for autonomous agents in the community’s hands to build, inspect and improve — accelerating development and hardening its safeguards.

sourceContent.headline: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Donation and New AI Infrastructure
sourceContent.description: At KubeCon, NVIDIA is putting tools to secure agents and run AI on Kubernetes in the hands of the cloud-native community.
paragraphs: Three new open source projects extend the DSX AI Factory Platform to make Kubernetes easier to run and inference faster to scale.

NVIDIA’s contribution of OpenShell to CNCF puts security infrastructure for autonomous agents in the community’s hands to build, inspect and improve — accelerating development and hardening its safeguards.
To help meet them, NVIDIA is deepening its commitment to open source at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon , the flagship conference for the Kubernetes and cloud-native communities.
Kubernetes, the open source system that manages how applications run across thousands of AI factories, has become the foundation for AI, and the demands on it are only growing.

NVIDIA is contributing NVIDIA OpenShell , an open source runtime for securing and governing autonomous agents, to the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF), a nonprofit that is part of the Linux Foundation and the host of KubeCon. As a CNCF Sandbox project, OpenShell will be governed by the organizations building it into their products and strengthened by the expertise of security professionals worldwide.

summaryLinesEn: Arm's Jeff DeFilippi spoke with @TheNextPlatform to share why latency, concurrency, and completed tasks per rack matter when evaluating infrastructure for agentic AI workloads.

sourceContent.headline: Amazon Bedrock tokenomics data lake | Amazon Web Services
sourceContent.description: Running Amazon Bedrock across many accounts shows you the bill but not what happened inside each call. This post builds a centralized observability data lake that aggregates Bedrock invocation logs from every linked account into one queryable table, so you can see prompts, token counts, model choice, and per-invocation cost across your organization.
paragraphs: You can’t debug a spike, you can’t spot wasteful prompts, and you can’t tell one team’s usage from another’s.
If you need an observability data lake for your Amazon Bedrock workloads, you’re not alone.
We built something to help: a centralized observability data lake for your Amazon Bedrock invocations.

If you need an observability data lake for your Amazon Bedrock workloads, you’re not alone. When you’re running thousands of model invocations a day across multiple accounts, after a request is sent you might be wondering, what happened? You can see the aggregate bill, but you can’t see what happened inside each call.

You might start to ask questions: what prompt was sent, what the model returned, how many tokens it used, which model handled it, and whether the response was any good! If you’re a platform or machine learning (ML) engineer looking after a fleet of Amazon Bedrock workloads across teams, that’s a real problem. sourceContent.headline: How TCS built an agentic test orchestrator with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
sourceContent.description: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) built an agentic test orchestrator on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that turns requirements into executable, governed tests for its Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) clients. Learn how specialized agents, per-tenant isolation, and workload-aware execution cut testing effort by 88% in an internal benchmark.
paragraphs: Second, AgentCore runtime, a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, scales with demand, so testers across many tenants can run generation and execution sessions at the same time without TCS provisioning or tuning agent servers.

Amazon Bedrock AgentCore hosts and scales the agents, Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases supply the AI capabilities and project context, Amazon EKS hosts the per-tenant application layer, Amazon ECS provides fit-for-purpose execution, and AWS security, storage, integration, and observability services support the full lifecycle.
BFSI clients need to increase testing throughput while preserving the controls expected in financial services.
This post was co-written with Varun Valsan from Tata Consultancy Services (TCS).

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) runs large-scale testing for Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) clients, where the slowest part of a release is rarely writing application code. The larger constraint is the chain of work that follows: interpreting requirements, designing scenarios, writing and maintaining automation, preparing execution environments, investigating failures, and assembling evidence for review.

BFSI clients need to increase testing throughput while preserving the controls expected in financial services. The objective wasn’t to replace quality engineers. It was to remove repetitive translation and execution work so that engineers could spend more time on risk analysis, exploratory testing, and release decisions. These industry needs generated four specific requirements for TCS. First, every test must be grounded in project-specific context rather than generic prompts. Second, it had to cover both API and browser-based UI testing to match how BFSI applications are built. Third, security is paramount, so every tenant’s data and knowledge store must be isolated. Finally, it must provide a repeatable path from requirement ingestion to test evidence and reporting, so the gains hold across teams and releases. In this post, we show how TCS built an agentic test orchestrator that turns requirements into executable, governed tests, and what it changed for its BFSI testing teams.

articles.titleEn: Inside the Arm Mali G2-Ultra NX GPU: Delivering desktop-class mobile gameplay with AI-native graphics
summaryLinesEn: Mali G2-Ultra NX is built for neural graphics from the ground up, with neural accelerators tightly integrated into the shader cores, allowing neural graphics workloads to run alongside graphics and compute workloads.
That shift is at the heart of the Arm Mali G2-Ultra NX GPU .

Neural Dawn , developed by Arm and Sumo Digital, showcases how developers can integrate NFRU and NSSD into a production game pipeline, delivering up to 4x higher performance efficiency and up to 70 percent lower external memory traffic compared with native rendering.

Demands from mobile users continue to grow. They want richer visuals, smoother frame rates, and increasingly immersive experiences. For developers the challenge is complex, as they aim to meet these expectations while staying within the strict power, thermal, and bandwidth limits of mobile devices.

Traditional rendering can deliver high image quality, but reaching desktop-class visual fidelity within mobile constraints demands greater efficiency. Neural graphics offers another path, using AI to reconstruct detail, generate intermediate frames, and refine images while reducing GPU demands and overall system workload.

Neural graphics offers another path, using AI to reconstruct detail, generate intermediate frames, and refine images while reducing GPU demands and overall system workload.

sourceLines: Mali G2-Ultra NX is built for neural graphics from the ground up, with neural accelerators tightly integrated into the shader cores, allowing neural graphics workloads to run alongside graphics and compute workloads.
That shift is at the heart of the Arm Mali G2-Ultra NX GPU .

Neural Dawn , developed by Arm and Sumo Digital, showcases how developers can integrate NFRU and NSSD into a production game pipeline, delivering up to 4x higher performance efficiency and up to 70 percent lower external memory traffic compared with native rendering.

articles.title: Spotify's AI DJ gets new voices, personalities, and an option for less chatter
articles.descEn: Spotify Premium users can now customize their AI DJ with new voices with different personalities, or turn off the commentary between songs.
articles.titleEn: Spotify's AI DJ gets new voices, personalities, and an option for less chatter
summaryLinesEn: In addition to the other various regional accents, there are also two new Spanish voices, one that’s more down-to-earth (Nico) and one that’s more witty and friendly (Fabi).
With the update, Spotify Premium subscribers will be able to choose from an expanded set of AI DJ voices in both English and Spanish.
On Tuesday, the streamer announced that users will now be able to customize their DJ more like they can an AI assistant, by choosing between different voices and personalities.

sourceContent.headline: Spotify's AI DJ gets new voices, personalities, and an option for less chatter
sourceContent.description: Spotify Premium users can now customize their AI DJ with new voices with different personalities, or turn off the commentary between songs.
paragraphs: In addition to the other various regional accents, there are also two new Spanish voices, one that’s more down-to-earth (Nico) and one that’s more witty and friendly (Fabi).
With the update, Spotify Premium subscribers will be able to choose from an expanded set of AI DJ voices in both English and Spanish.
On Tuesday, the streamer announced that users will now be able to customize their DJ more like they can an AI assistant, by choosing between different voices and personalities.

Spotify’s AI DJ, one of the company’s earlier efforts in embracing AI technology to connect people with their favorite music, is getting an upgrade. On Tuesday, the streamer announced that users will now be able to customize their DJ more like they can an AI assistant, by choosing between different voices and personalities. Those who like the feature, but not all the chatter, can also now opt for an experience with less commentary in between sets.

Since first launching the AI DJ in 2023 , Spotify has leveraged AI across to improve all areas of its app. Most recently, that has included updates that allow users to chat with a conversational AI agent about music, fine-tune their recommendations with prompts , create playlists with AI, and work with third-party agents like ChatGPT and Claude. However, the DJ remains one of Spotify’s most popular AI features, as it’s used by over 94M Spotify Premium listeners.
Now, it’s revisiting one of its first major AI features, taking a cue from the personalization options other AI assistants routinely offer.

sourceContent.headline: Adobe Firefly AI Assistant can now take on recurring tasks for you - Engadget
sourceContent.description: Adobe announced its latest flight of AI-powered tools at its Max conference today.
paragraphs: In a preview the company shared with Engadget, it demoed a user prompting Firefly AI Assistant to sort through footage as it was being uploaded to a project.
As you can imagine, the agent is designed to help users make edits using natural language.
You can also select a specific model to orchestrate the tasks or leave that decision up to Adobe's software.
The company is also bringing an agent to the Premiere mobile app.

Few companies have embraced artificial intelligence quite like Adobe. Between Photoshop, Premiere and Illustrator, the company has brought its Firefly assistant, and other generative AI features, to much of its Creative Cloud suite. Adobe is showing no signs of slowing down. At its Max conference in Miami today, the company announced a significant expansion to Creative Cloud's agentic capabilities.

To start, taking a page from Anthropic and OpenAI , Adobe is dipping its toes into the world of proactive agents. An updated version of its Firefly AI Assistant can now carry out multi-step tasks. When you give the AI Assistant a job, a new planning mode allows you to review and edit the agent's proposed workflow before giving it approval to move forward. You can also select a specific model to orchestrate the tasks or leave that decision up to Adobe's software. For example, you can now define colors and brand guidelines that will apply across projects the assistant takes on for you.

articles.title: A New AI Tool From Google DeepMind Proved the Signal Protocol Is Secure
articles.descEn: DeepMind researchers were able to formally verify that the widely used encryption protocol works as intended. Their stretch goal? Do the same for “all the software of the world.”
articles.titleEn: A New AI Tool From Google DeepMind Proved the Signal Protocol Is Secure
summaryLinesEn: Agentic AI can significantly cut down the time of the latter project, enabling analyses like DeepMind's Signal evaluation.
DeepMind conducted the Signal analysis free of charge as a research project, and Google declined to share the cost of the analysis.

While the speed of the project was notable, the DeepMind researchers point out that they were able to get a head start to a degree because of some past formal verification work that the Signal Foundation has conducted.

articles.title: Anthropic joins AI’s natural gas frenzy, buys $3.4B worth of turbines
articles.descEn: Anthropic bought billions of dollars' worth of natural gas turbines in a deal that could give it buyer's remorse.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic joins AI’s natural gas frenzy, buys $3.4B worth of turbines
summaryLinesEn: AI’s power crunch has become so acute that Anthropic, a company that has generally avoided buying physical infrastructure, is spending $3.4 billion on natural gas turbines.
The company disclosed in its S-1 filing in May that it is paying SpaceX subsidiary xAI $1.25 billion per month through May 2029 to use xAI’s computing power.
The generators are capable of producing up to 1.7 gigawatts of electricity.

articles.title: David Ellison says AI could be the ‘biggest creative unlock in modern history’
articles.descEn: Paramount Skydance CEO David Ellison said in an earnings call that AI will ”significantly” reshape its business, and compared its impact on film to CGI.
articles.titleEn: David Ellison says AI could be the ‘biggest creative unlock in modern history’
summaryLinesEn: As a result of those tools, Ellison claims, “content will be easier to produce, projects across the organization will speed up, and how we work will transform.”
Ellison gave Terminator as an example, describing how it cost $4 million to make, but “if you wanted to make that picture today, shot for shot, it’s $60 to 70 million.”
During Paramount Skydance’s latest earnings call , CEO David Ellison said “it’s hard to imagine” AI won’t have a bigger impact on the film industry than CGI.

articles.title: Apple’s $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features
articles.descEn: Apple has started selling $50 usage packs, giving users continued access to Creator Studio AI features that have usage limits.
articles.titleEn: Apple’s $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features
summaryLinesEn: Users finding themselves running out of access can find the option to buy an Intelligence Usage Pack in the Intelligence Features > Show Usage section of the app’s main menu.

After publishing a support article in early September outlining usage limits for some Apple Intelligence features, the company has updated Logic Pro with an option to “Buy More Usage” for a one-time purchase price of $49.99, as spotted by 9to5Mac .

These Intelligence Usage Packs, as Apple calls them, will allow users to continue accessing certain Apple Intelligence features that have usage limits because they rely on cloud-based AI models from OpenAI or Google Gemini.

articles.title: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 cement Anthropic's AI lead just before its IPO
articles.descEn: Anthropic is releasing Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, its most powerful models to date, in two versions: one freely available and one reserved for verified organizations. The models solve open physics problems, show stronger cybersecurity capabilities, design functioning operating systems, and write more than 90 percent of the changes merged into Anthropic's core code, according to the company. Anthropic says it has deliberately curbed any capabilities that would let the AI accelerate its own development.
articles.titleEn: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 cement Anthropic's AI lead just before its IPO
summaryLinesEn: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 share the same model foundation but, just like their predecessors, differ in access.
Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 reclaim the AI performance lead shortly before the company's IPO, in some cases by a wide margin.
Ad The models produce output up to 30 percent faster than Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, Anthropic says.

articles.title: IBM's enterprise AI operating model takes shape - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: IBM is building an enterprise AI operating model around hybrid cloud, agent orchestration, trusted data and governance to bring AI into production.
articles.titleEn: IBM's enterprise AI operating model takes shape - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: IBM already has a substantial book of business around generative AI, with AI-related software sales and consulting engagements totaling more than $12.5 billion as of Q4 2025 , up from $9.5 billion the previous quarter.

This feature is part of SiliconANGLE Media’s exploration of how enterprise AI has moved beyond the race for model supremacy, with major technology players now focused on enabling governed enterprise AI that delivers trust, reliability and predictable business outcomes.
Its goal is to help companies maintain operational consistency even as AI regulations and geopolitics constantly shift.

articles.title: The climate case for AI has not been made
articles.descEn: AI leaders claim their tech will fix the climate. The evidence mostly points in the opposite direction so far.
articles.titleEn: The climate case for AI has not been made
summaryLinesEn: At this point it would be surprising if the sector even manages to zero out its climate pollution: Emissions associated with global data centers (which may handle AI as well as non-AI computing tasks) could exceed 300 million tons annually in 2035, according to the IEA’s base forecast .
CATL—which controls roughly 40% of the global market for electric-vehicle batteries—launched an AI system trained on more than 100,000 battery design cases and 600 terabytes of test data.

A peer-reviewed study published last year, led by researchers at the London School of Economics’ Grantham Research Institute and the firm Systemiq, estimated that AI could help cut global emissions by the equivalent of 3.2 to 5.4 billion tons of carbon dioxide annually by 2035—roughly on par with the US’s annual energy-related emissions on the high end, even after subtracting AI’s own energy footprint.
articles.summary:
At this point it would be surprising if the sector even manages to zero out its climate pollution: Emissions associated with global data centers (which may handle AI as well as non-AI computing tasks) could exceed 300 million tons annually in 2035, according to the IEA’s base forecast .
CATL—which controls roughly 40% of the global market for electric-vehicle batteries—launched an AI system trained on more than 100,000 battery design cases and 600 terabytes of test data.
A peer-reviewed study published last year, led by researchers at the London School of Economics’ Grantham Research Institute and the firm Systemiq, estimated that AI could help cut global emissions by the equivalent of 3.2 to 5.4 billion tons of carbon dioxide annually by 2035—roughly on par with the US’s annual energy-related emissions on the high end, even after subtracting AI’s own energy footprint.

localization.title: AI에 대한 기후 사례는 아직 만들어지지 않았음
summaryLines: 현 시점에서 해당 부문이 기후 오염을 완전히 제거할 수 있다면 놀라운 일이 될 것임 · IEA의 기본 예측에 따르면 글로벌 데이터 센터(AI 및 비AI 컴퓨팅 작업을 처리할 수 있음)와 관련된 배출량은 2035년에 연간 3억 톤을 초과할 수 있음
전 세계 전기 자동차 배터리 시장의 약 40%를 장악하고 있는 CATL은 100,000개 이상의 배터리 설계 사례와 600테라바이트의 테스트 데이터를 학습한 AI 시스템을 출시함

런던 정경대학(London School of Economics)의 Grantham Research Institute와 Systemiq 회사의 연구자들이 주도한 동료 검토 연구에서는 AI가 2035년까지 연간 32억~54억 톤에 달하는 이산화탄소 배출량을 줄이는 데 도움이 될 수 있다고 추정함 · 이는 AI의 자체 에너지 발자국을 차감한 후에도 미국의 연간 에너지 관련 배출량과 대략 비슷한 수준임

articles.title: Nvidia espionage scandal weakens Huang's lobby against tighter AI chip export controls
articles.descEn: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has admitted to an extramarital affair with a woman US intelligence agencies classify as a suspected Chinese informant. The board has launched an independent investigation. The affair weakens Huang's lobbying efforts against stricter AI chip export controls, with a newly elected Democratic Congress poised to ramp up scrutiny of AI chip smuggling to China and push for tighter restrictions.

summaryLines: 이 사건은 더욱 엄격한 미국 수출 통제에 대한 Nvidia의 입장을 약화시키고 리더십 위험을 높임 · Huang은 대부분 승계 계획 없이 회사를 운영하고 지배 지분을 보유하지 않기 때문임

summaryLinesEn: FormAssembly, founded in 2006, raised its first outside funding of $10 million in 2019 after 13 years of bootstrapping.

“You can explain what you need in plain English to your agent, and the agent will build the entire process in a couple of minutes,” Savarese said.

articles.descEn: On the latest episode of theCUBE Pod, John Furrier and Dave Vellante discuss the Wall Street fallout from midterms.
articles.titleEn: On theCUBE Pod: Midterms send shockwaves through AI market - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Tech stocks fell, with a collective loss of $2.5 trillion in market cap , and the Nasdaq dropped more than 5.5%.
A GPU-based AI economy will shift in the next several years, Furrier believes, which could lead to surprising winners and losers.
He thinks the tech titans are in a solid position while neoclouds are taking on a greater share of risk by pioneering a new software model, although not all of them will make it in the long term.

articles.title: Meta is expanding AI age detection for Instagram teen accounts - Engadget
articles.descEn: The company will increase its use of the tech on Facebook and Threads too.
articles.titleEn: Meta is expanding AI age detection for Instagram teen accounts - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Update, November 9, 2026, 2:12PM ET: A previous version of this story indicated that Meta is using bone structure analysis of photos, as well as mentions of things like school grades or birthday celebrations to estimate a person's age.
If the systems determine the person is aged between 13 and 17, they'll be funneled into a teen account, even if they used an adult date of birth while signing up.
In August, the company reached an agreement (under which it may have to pay as much as $18 billion) with 52 attorneys general to settle a lawsuit that alleged harms to young users of its apps.

summaryLines: 업데이트, 2026년 11월 9일 오후 2시 12분(ET): 이 이야기의 이전 버전에서는 Meta가 사진의 뼈 구조 분석을 사용하고 학교 성적이나 생일 축하와 같은 언급을 사용하여 사람의 나이를 추정하고 있음을 나타냄

articles.title: Authors Can Defend Against AI Allegations With ‘Paper Trail’ Tools. Is It Enough?
articles.descEn: As the publishing industry wrestles with paranoia over the provenance of manuscripts, writers are caught in an impossible bind.
articles.titleEn: Authors Can Defend Against AI Allegations With ‘Paper Trail’ Tools. Is It Enough?
summaryLinesEn: While Pangram claims an “industry-leading” false positive rate of 0.01 percent when used on creative writing, Rasenberger said the Authors Guild has “heard of lots of instances where people have put their own human-authored work in Pangram and gotten a result back saying it was AI-generated.”

Rasenberger worries that authors are up against a climate of distrust—they should “refrain from accusations of other authors because it just does not support a healthy literary community,” she says—and overconfidence in AI detection tools, which can be fooled and have been known to produce false positives.
According to Pangram , a robust but by no means infallible AI detection tool, some 78 percent of the text was AI-generated.

summaryLines: Pangram은 창의적인 글쓰기에 사용될 때 "업계 최고의" 오탐률이 0.01%라고 주장하지만 Rasenberger는 Authors Guild가 "사람들이 자신의 인간 저작물을 Pangram에 넣고 그것이 AI로 생성되었다는 결과를 얻은 사례를 많이 들었다"고 말함

articles.title: Medium's new TK app brings AI assistance directly into the writing process
articles.descEn: Medium's new writing app embraces AI-assisted writing, despite growing controversy over the technology's role in publishing.
articles.titleEn: Medium's new TK app brings AI assistance directly into the writing process
summaryLinesEn: “This is a start of what we believe is required to publish in the AI era, which is to make the provenance of writing clear, transparent, and inspectable, right down to the prompting and source material,” Medium explained in a blog post about the launch.
Online publishing platform Medium on Monday launched a new app, called TK, which aims to bring AI technology deeper into the writing process.
The company suggests the AI assistant could help answer questions that you might normally have to switch to another tab to quickly look up, like how many days are in a particular month.

articles.title: Nancy Pelosi’s replacement is ready to regulate AI
articles.descEn: As a California state senator, Scott Wiener authored legislation aimed at curbing the risks of advanced AI. Now, after winning a tight congressional race for former Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi’s open San Francisco seat, he could play a key role in setting federal AI policy. I spoke with Wiener on Friday, only a…
articles.titleEn: Nancy Pelosi’s replacement is ready to regulate AI
summaryLinesEn: Wiener’s congressional campaign received over $3 million from Public First Action, a nonprofit in favor of AI regulation that receives substantial funding from Anthropic.

The fact that voters approved 40 out of 41 anti-data-center ballot measures on Tuesday might seem to be a good sign for Wiener and others who support AI regulation, but Wiener says he sees this movement as far more tied to local concerns than to bigger questions about AI risk.
Once you’re in that realm, that really is potentially a recipe for total loss of control.”

articles.title: 令和7年度厚生労働省 老人保健健康増進等事業・社会福祉推進事業・障害者総合福祉推進事業
articles.titleEn: 令和7年度厚生労働省 老人保健健康増進等事業・社会福祉推進事業・障害者総合福祉推進事業
summaryLinesEn: BCP 作成を行動に変える、平時の体制整備ハンドブック～災害への備えと「対話」～ （前半）令和7年度 社会福祉推進事業 医療扶助における多剤・重複投薬対策等の効果的かつ効率的な実施方法等に関する調査研究 報告書 （後半）令和7年度 社会福祉推進事業 医療扶助における多剤・重複投薬対策等の効果的かつ効率的な実施方法等に関する調査研究 報告書 令和7年度 障害者総合福祉推進事業 共同生活援助の質の確保のための（自立支援）協議会の役割等に関する実態調査 報告書
（株）野村総合研究所では、厚生労働省の補助金を受けて、老人保健健康増進等事業・社会福祉推進事業・障害者総合福祉推進事業として下記の調査研究を実施しました。
本調査研究事業は、福祉事務所が実施する被保護者健康管理支援事業等の実態把握を行うとともに、「被保護者健康管理支援事業の手引き（第2版）」の改定方策を検討すること、同時に、令和7年度より始まった都道府県による市町村支援の実施実態等を把握すること等を目的として実施した。

articles.title: 減少する児童館の新たな役割
articles.titleEn: 減少する児童館の新たな役割
summaryLinesEn: 担い手が多様化するなかで、公的施設である児童館が、地域でどのような役割を果たすのかが、あらためて問われている。
一方、児童館の数は2006年の4,718館をピークに減少し、24年には4,248館となった。
2023年12月に「こどもの居場所づくりに関する指針」が閣議決定されるなど、こどもの居場所づくりは政策として推進され、こども食堂や学習支援の場など、NPOや地域住民が担う多様な居場所が全国で広がっている。

summaryLinesEn: 本誌2024年10月号で述べたように、技術を使う側には新たな仕組みの導入に伴うリスクへの懸念が、売る側には販売の見通しが立たず開発や営業に人員・資金を振り向けにくいという事情があり、双方に障壁が存在する。
政府が目視や現地での確認などを求める約1万条項のアナログ規制を見直したことは、意義ある一歩であった。

articles.title: 2026 APAC Shopping Season Playbook
articles.descEn: Explore APAC’s 2026 shopping seasons, from Singles’ Day to Diwali, Lunar New Year, and Ramadan. See app and ad trends, standout markets & categories.
articles.titleEn: 2026 APAC Shopping Season Playbook
summaryLinesEn: Global shopping app downloads are forecast to reach 6.43 billion in 2026 , remaining above 6 billion for a fourth consecutive year.

China shows a different pattern: mid-year activity overlaps with the 618 festival, and the 2026 forecast peaks in October, within the broader Golden Week and Singles’ Day promotional window, before easing.
These differences support planning around multiple local shopping occasions rather than applying one year-end campaign calendar across the region.

articles.title: NVIDIA Dynamo Recipes Bring Korea’s Leading Open Models to Production
articles.descEn: NVIDIA is releasing Dynamo-optimized deployment recipes for Korea’s leading open models.
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA Dynamo Recipes Bring Korea’s Leading Open Models to Production
summaryLinesEn: Optimized for NVIDIA B200 GPUs, these recipes take the guesswork out of deployment, delivering up to 2x performance out of the box.
They help developers bring Korea’s open models into production faster and turn them into broadly accessible AI for All services.

NVIDIA is releasing Dynamo-optimized deployment recipes for Korea’s leading open models: A.X K2 from SK Telecom , K-EXAONE 2.0 from LG AI Research , Solar Open 2 from Upstage and Motif-3 from Motif Technologies .

articles.title: From Chips to Skills, NVIDIA and Korea Expand Sovereign AI Collaboration
articles.descEn: NVIDIA and Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) are expanding their collaboration across the country’s sovereign AI ecosystem, from AI semiconductors and data center infrastructure to talent, startups, models, agents and security.
articles.titleEn: From Chips to Skills, NVIDIA and Korea Expand Sovereign AI Collaboration
summaryLinesEn: NVIDIA and Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) are expanding their collaboration across the country’s sovereign AI ecosystem, from AI semiconductors and data center infrastructure to talent, startups, models, agents and security.

The collaboration lays the groundwork for Korean NPU and XPU companies to explore participation in the NVIDIA NVLink Fusion ecosystem, and includes NVIDIA training and certification programs, hackathons and technical seminars to strengthen GPU utilization.

Through Korea’s AI for All initiative, NVIDIA will collaborate with three selected consortia and four leading Korean foundation model builders, using NVIDIA Dynamo software to optimize and scale AI inference.

summaryLines: 엔비디아와 한국 과학기술정보통신부(MSIT)는 AI 반도체와 데이터센터 인프라부터 인재, 스타트업, 모델, 에이전트, 보안에 이르기까지 국가의 AI 생태계 전반에 걸쳐 협력을 확대하고 있음

한국의 AI for All 이니셔티브를 통해 NVIDIA는 선정된 3개의 컨소시엄 및 4개의 주요 한국 기반 모델 구축업체와 협력하여 NVIDIA Dynamo 소프트웨어를 사용하여 AI 추론을 최적화하고 확장할 예정임

articles.title: Korea’s AI Ecosystem Advances and Secures Agentic AI With NVIDIA
articles.descEn: Hyundai Motor Group and AIM Intelligence explore NVIDIA NemoClaw and OpenShell for secure enterprise agents, and LG AI Research opens API for ‘K-EXAONE-2.5’ trained on Nemotron datasets.
articles.titleEn: Korea’s AI Ecosystem Advances and Secures Agentic AI With NVIDIA
summaryLinesEn: Nemotron-Personas-Korea is an open dataset of 7 million fully synthetic Korean personas, grounded in official Korean statistics, that model builders use to ground training data and evaluation in Korean contexts.
As AI agents take on more work, they need capable open models and security that advances alongside them.
On the model side, LG AI Research is opening application programming interface access for K-EXAONE-2.5, developed using NVIDIA Nemotron datasets, including Nemotron-Personas-Korea .

articles.title: NVIDIA Announces New Planned Investments in Korean Startups at the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum
articles.descEn: Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT and NVIDIA hosted the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum at COEX.
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA Announces New Planned Investments in Korean Startups at the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum
summaryLinesEn: NVIDIA also announced an investment in Korean startup Point2 , with additional investments planned in Motif Technologies , RLWRLD and Upstage.

The planned investments build on NVIDIA’s work with Korea’s startup and venture community, including more than 1,000 Korea-based members of NVIDIA Inception , a program that helps startups grow with access to preferred pricing, technical expertise and opportunities for investor introductions.

Point2 Technology, an AI interconnect company, builds scalable, radio frequency-based interconnects that move data between chips and racks in AI factories, offering an innovative alternative to conventional copper and optical interconnect solutions for AI cluster scale-up, delivering the reach, performance and efficiency needed for next-generation AI infrastructure.

articles.title: The Radish AI team joins Lovable to scale agentic capabilities for businesses | Lovable
articles.descEn: Lovable has acquired the team behind Radish AI, an agentic infrastructure platform. Its co-founders join our engineering team in London and Stockholm to build the agent capabilities and infrastructure behind Lovable.
articles.titleEn: The Radish AI team joins Lovable to scale agentic capabilities for businesses | Lovable
summaryLinesEn: Adrian Zgorzałek spent 12 years at Meta leading developer experience and infrastructure efforts across social graph distributed systems, privacy infrastructure, and GraphQL.

As millions of people build with Lovable, more of them are using it to run and grow their businesses—from tools that help them manage their operations to the software their whole company runs on, increasingly with AI automating core processes.
That's why we're excited to announce that Lovable has acquired the team behind Radish AI.

localization.title: Radish AI 팀, 기업용 에이전트 기능 확장을 위해 Lovable에 합류 | 사랑스럽
summaryLines: Adrian Zgorzałek은 Meta에서 12년 동안 소셜 그래프 분산 시스템, 개인 정보 보호 인프라 및 GraphQL 전반에 걸쳐 개발자 경험과 인프라 노력을 주도함
수백만 명의 사람들이 Lovable을 사용하여 구축함에 따라 운영 관리에 도움이 되는 도구부터 회사 전체가 실행하는 소프트웨어에 이르기까지 비즈니스를 운영하고 성장시키는 데 더 많은 사람들이 Lovable을 사용하고 있으며 AI가 핵심 프로세스를 자동화하는 경우가 점점 늘어나고 있음
이것이 바로 우리가 Lovable이 Radish AI 팀을 인수했다는 소식을 발표하게 되어 기쁘게 생각하는 이유임

articles.title: Practice Makes Precise: At CoRL, NVIDIA and Partners Reveal How Robots Rehearse Delicate Work in Simulation
articles.descEn: At the Conference on Robot Learning, NVIDIA is introducing GR00T 2, Isaac Lab 3.0 and new open benchmarks, built in collaboration with partners, bringing precision and scale to robot training.
articles.titleEn: Practice Makes Precise: At CoRL, NVIDIA and Partners Reveal How Robots Rehearse Delicate Work in Simulation
summaryLinesEn: Its latest release, Isaac Lab 3.0 , allows researchers to use agents to quickly set up training environments with simulation-ready assets , switch between NVIDIA PhysX and Newton physics solvers , choose renderers for perception-based training and apply a new reinforcement post-training library to foundation models like GR00T.

The shift from locomotion to manipulation is taking center stage at this week’s Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) in Austin, Texas, alongside the rise of agentic robotics — a new paradigm that integrates frontier agents to create interpretable code for physical robotics systems.
Trained on diverse robot and human data, including 100,000 hours of NVIDIA open source human egocentric data , the model enables robots to learn dexterous manipulation skills.

summaryLines: 최신 릴리스인 Isaac Lab 3.0을 통해 연구자는 에이전트를 사용하여 시뮬레이션 지원 자산으로 교육 환경을 신속하게 설정하고, NVIDIA PhysX와 Newton 물리 솔버 간 전환하고, 인식 기반 교육을 위한 렌더러를 선택하고, GR00T와 같은 기초 모델에 새로운 강화 사후 교육 라이브러리를 적용할 수 있음
이동에서 조작으로의 전환은 이번 주 텍사스주 오스틴에서 열리는 로봇 학습 컨퍼런스(CoRL)에서 에이전트 로봇공학의 부상과 함께 중심 무대로 자리잡고 있음 · 에이전트 로봇공학은 물리적 로봇 시스템을 위한 해석 가능한 코드를 생성하기 위해 프론티어 에이전트를 통합하는 새로운 패러다임임
100,000시간의 NVIDIA 오픈 소스 인간 자기 중심 데이터를 포함하여 다양한 로봇 및 인간 데이터에 대해 훈련된 이 모델을 통해 로봇은 능숙한 조작 기술을 배울 수 있음

articles.title: Nemotron-Personas-Finance-Japan: A Synthetic Dataset Capturing Japan's Demographics and Financial Context
articles.descEn: A Blog post by NVIDIA on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: Nemotron-Personas-Finance-Japan: A Synthetic Dataset Capturing Japan's Demographics and Financial Context
summaryLinesEn: It holds 9M personas, 50% more than Nemotron-Personas-Japan, across 50 fields instead of 22.

Open Data Breaking Down Privacy Barriers to Pave the Way for AI in Finance A compound AI approach to Japanese personas grounded in real-world distributions In the financial sector, the utilization of real-world data faces significant constraints due to strict privacy regulations, compliance requirements, and the need for advanced domain expertise.

In this context, the development of agentic AI in the financial domain requires synthetic data capable of avoiding the risks of using real data while reflecting demographics, household structures, and asset statuses to reproduce diverse, realistic financial scenarios.

articles.title: Turn buying signals into pipeline with Sendoso gifts in Genie One | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Sales, marketing and customer success teams can turn intent signals into approved gifts in Genie One with Sendoso's MCP server, and track what they drive.
articles.titleEn: Turn buying signals into pipeline with Sendoso gifts in Genie One | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Gift history lives in the same workspace as pipeline data, so teams can report on the deals each gift influenced and manage gifting like any other investment.
Gifting is worth the effort because other channels are crowded: Sendoso's 2026 Digital Fatigue Report found 84% of buyers are fatigued by cold calls and 83% by marketing emails.
Sendoso's MCP server brings gifting and direct mail into Genie One, so business teams can turn an intent signal from their own data into a previewed, approved gift in one conversation.

localization.title: Genie One의 Sendoso 선물로 구매 신호를 파이프라인으로 전환 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
summaryLines: 선물 내역은 파이프라인 데이터와 동일한 작업 공간에 있으므로 팀은 각 선물이 영향을 준 거래에 대해 보고하고 다른 투자와 마찬가지로 선물을 관리할 수 있음
다른 채널이 붐비기 때문에 선물을 주는 것은 노력할 가치가 있음 · Sendoso의 2026년 디지털 피로 보고서에 따르면 구매자의 84%는 콜드 콜로, 83%는 마케팅 이메일로 피로를 느끼는 것으로 나타남
Sendoso의 MCP 서버는 Genie One에 선물 및 다이렉트 메일을 제공하므로 비즈니스 팀은 한 번의 대화를 통해 자체 데이터의 의도 신호를 미리 보고 승인된 선물로 전환할 수 있음

articles.title: Professional work deserves professional tools. Meet AWS Quick. | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Introducing AWS Quick, formerly Amazon Quick, and the debut of our first brand campaign celebrating teams who keep business moving. AWS Quick is the AI workspace built only for work, where teams use AI agents to research, analyze, and act across the data and applications they already rely on.
articles.titleEn: Professional work deserves professional tools. Meet AWS Quick. | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: You bring the judgment, and Quick gives your team the capacity to match its goals.
Quick knows your role, your team, and how your projects, people, and data connect, because it works across the applications and workflows your teams already use.
Because context stays locked inside a single project or one vendor’s suite, productivity never compounds across the team or the company.

articles.title: Claude can design electronic prototypes from start to finish
articles.descEn: We asked Claude to design three electronic devices: a speakerphone, a voice-assistant hub, and a handheld virtual pet. The prototypes worked without any fixes to their circuitry.
articles.titleEn: Claude can design electronic prototypes from start to finish
summaryLinesEn: You have to not only design and simulate a circuit board, but also reason about the board’s physical layout and how it will behave, model the mechanical components, and write firmware—all while keeping track of which parts are readily available and what a factory is set up to build.
Because the devices are early prototypes, we don’t yet know how they’ll hold up with continued use or whether they would pass commercial certifications.

To see how newer Claude models have improved in this area, we collaborated with Diode again, this time asking Claude Fable 5.2 to design three electronic devices: a speakerphone, a voice-assistant hub, and a handheld virtual pet.

summaryLines: 회로 기판을 설계하고 시뮬레이션할 뿐만 아니라 기판의 물리적 레이아웃과 작동 방식을 추론하고, 기계 구성 요소를 모델링하고, 펌웨어를 작성하는 동시에 어떤 부품을 쉽게 사용할 수 있는지, 어떤 공장이 구축되어 있는지 추적해야 함

articles.title: How CrossnoKaye grounds physical AI with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: CrossnoKaye brought physical AI to heavy industry with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Its ATLAS platform and AURA agentic system ground AI reasoning in live plant data and run verifiable Python in isolated AgentCore sandboxes, giving plant engineers checkable, math-backed answers instead of model guesses.
articles.titleEn: How CrossnoKaye grounds physical AI with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Figure 1: CrossnoKaye AURA and ATLAS physical AI architecture with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore First, the plant is defined in software from the edge up.
At an aggregates quarry running primary, secondary, and tertiary rock crushers, the back half of the plant tripped twice in a single shift.

Because ATLAS already manages the facility model, the base control software, the historian, and the optimization applications in one platform on AWS, CrossnoKaye’s agentic intelligence system, AURA, has native access to the full operational state of the plant within a single security boundary.

summaryLinesEn: Getting it into a distributed training job means picking one of three workarounds, and each one costs you time and money:

Most training data for your models already lives in Unity Catalog tables.

articles.title: Databricks' Commitment to European Sovereignty | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Databricks is expanding its European sovereignty capabilities across both AWS and Azure, enabling organizations to meet evolving data-residency and sovereignty requirements on the cloud of their choice.
articles.titleEn: Databricks' Commitment to European Sovereignty | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Databricks is classified as a regional service on Azure and has been Azure EU Data Boundary compliant since EUDB launched.
That investment has always been driven by a specific philosophy: customers should control where their data lives, how it's protected, and who can access it.
In addition, European customers can now contract directly with a Databricks European Union (EU) entity, making procurement simpler for customers that require a European counterparty.

articles.descEn: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base now supports single-shot RAG and retrieval-only requests through AgenticRetrieveStream, alongside agentic retrieval. This post explains how the maxAgentIteration parameter matches retrieval effort to each request, using an illustrative internal banking policy assistant.

summaryLines: 3분기 디지털 시장 지수 보고서 · 환경에 대한 치트 시트 디지털 관심이 네이티브 앱으로 이동하여 관심이 웹에서 멀어짐 · 2026년 3분기 글로벌 웹 방문은 총 1조 9,600억 시간(-3% YoY)을 기록했으며, 사용자 관심이 네이티브 모바일 앱으로 이동함에 따라 소요 시간은 3,970억 시간(-4.4% YoY)으로 감소함

articles.title: How we moved our frontend off Firestore and built Lovable Realtime | Lovable
articles.descEn: How we replaced frontend Firestore listeners with a Go and NATS realtime service, with reactive authorization, server-shaped payloads, and 2.06 million live subscriptions.
articles.titleEn: How we moved our frontend off Firestore and built Lovable Realtime | Lovable
summaryLinesEn: The service handles peaks of over 2 million concurrent subscriptions and delivers around 2.6 billion data and patch frames per month.
We needed the backend to decide what each user received and keep that decision up to date as both the data and their permissions changed.

When a NATS message arrives, the pod dispatches it to every matching subscription instance, which re-evaluates its data projection, deduplicates via xxh3-128 hash, and pushes the deltas to the frontend if the output changed.

articles.title: How Smart Glasses Detector Apps Work, and How Much You Can Trust Them - CNET
articles.descEn: Detector apps can identify Meta’s glasses and similar devices by their Bluetooth signals, as long as they’re switched on, nearby and broadcasting.
articles.titleEn: How Smart Glasses Detector Apps Work, and How Much You Can Trust Them - CNET
summaryLinesEn: Smart glasses do the same thing, and apps such as Zuckoff listen for signals that match known models, then send an alert when one turns up nearby.

Unlike with smartphones, where it’s easier to tell when someone is recording or taking photos, “smart glasses shift the burden of privacy entirely onto the person being photographed,” Ananthakrishnan said.
“We made the decision from the beginning that smart glasses don’t need to have cameras on them in order to be useful,” Even Realities CEO Will Wang told CNET in an email.

sourceContent.headline: How Smart Glasses Detector Apps Work, and How Much You Can Trust Them - CNET
sourceContent.description: Detector apps can identify Meta’s glasses and similar devices by their Bluetooth signals, as long as they’re switched on, nearby and broadcasting.
paragraphs: Smart glasses do the same thing, and apps such as Zuckoff listen for signals that match known models, then send an alert when one turns up nearby.

Unlike with smartphones, where it’s easier to tell when someone is recording or taking photos, “smart glasses shift the burden of privacy entirely onto the person being photographed,” Ananthakrishnan said.
“We made the decision from the beginning that smart glasses don’t need to have cameras on them in order to be useful,” Even Realities CEO Will Wang told CNET in an email.
Detector apps can identify Meta’s glasses and similar devices by their Bluetooth signals, as long as they’re switched on, nearby and broadcasting.

Bluetooth devices announce themselves to nearby phones with short broadcast signals, which is how your earbuds show up when you open your phone’s Bluetooth menu. Smart glasses do the same thing, and apps such as Zuckoff listen for signals that match known models, then send an alert when one turns up nearby.

It’s a clever workaround for glasses designed to blend in. How useful it is depends on what you want it to tell you: The app can detect that a pair is close by, but not whether it’s recording. Still, that’s more notice than most people get today, especially if they haven’t spotted the glasses’ built-in LED indicator

articles.descEn: As autonomous AI agents work together, verifying their actions, enforcing security policies, and maintaining accountability becomes increasingly difficult
articles.titleEn: Can We Trust AI Agents When Zero Trust Isn’t Really Zero
summaryLinesEn: As autonomous AI agents work together, verifying their actions, enforcing security policies, and maintaining accountability becomes increasingly difficult Vishal Sharma is a Reader in the School of Electronics, Electrical Engineering, and Computer Science at Queen's University Belfast, Northern Ireland, United Kingdom.

In a de-authentication attack on an aerial vehicle using a human- and agent-in-the-loop approach, an AI agent can quickly scan the active channel and autonomously intercept traffic, thus reducing the time to react and regain control.

articles.title: ASML Falls 20% in the Past Month as AI Growth Meets Execution Risk
articles.descEn: ASML shares have plunged 20% in a month despite robust AI demand, as premium valuation, capacity expansion challenges and export risks cloud its growth outlook.
articles.titleEn: ASML Falls 20% in the Past Month as AI Growth Meets Execution Risk
summaryLinesEn: ASML shares have fallen 20% in the past month even as the company continues to report rising demand tied to artificial intelligence, advanced Logic and Memory capacity, and greater lithography intensity.
ASML reported €11.7 billion in total net sales, a 57.5% gross margin and €5.0 billion in net income, while Installed Base Management sales reached €3.3 billion.
ASML's operating momentum remains favorable, but its valuation, manufacturing expansion, export-control exposure and High-NA adoption timelines leave meaningful execution risk.

articles.title: Meta expands Instagram's AI age-guessing tech globally
articles.descEn: Meta says it will use its AI technology to look for clues about people it suspects to be teenagers — even if they use an adult birthday.
articles.titleEn: Meta expands Instagram's AI age-guessing tech globally
summaryLinesEn: The global expansion comes as Meta reached settlements worth up to $18 billion with nearly every U.S. state and territory in August to resolve lawsuits alleging its platforms harm teens.

Meta announced on Monday that it’s expanding its AI-powered age-estimation technology on Instagram worldwide to identify more teens and place them under its Teen Account protections, as it faces numerous lawsuits accusing its platforms of harming teens.
Meta said parents in the U.S. will start seeing an in-feed video on Instagram explaining its approach to ensuring their teens are in age-appropriate protections.

Meta said parents in the U.S. will start seeing an in-feed video on Instagram explaining its approach to ensuring their teens are in age-appropriate protections.

articles.title: I Used NYT Cooking’s New AI-Powered Recipe Modifier, and It’s Actually Pretty Good
articles.descEn: The New York Times has added a beta feature to its Cooking app that helps readers swap ingredients or adjust recipes to suit their needs. It mostly hits the mark.
articles.titleEn: I Used NYT Cooking’s New AI-Powered Recipe Modifier, and It’s Actually Pretty Good
summaryLinesEn: The Times doesn't share Cooking's subscriber numbers, but NYT executive communications director Jordan Cohen said the site and app were visited 514 million times in 2025, and its YouTube channel has over 1.4 million subscribers.

Earlier this year, the Times allowed AI to help with a recipe-scaling feature (modifying ingredient quantities so "serves 4" turns into "serves 6") and converting from imperial measurements to metric—cups, tablespoons, and Fahrenheit to grams, milliliters, and Celsius.

It thought about it for a moment—"simmering" in AI Cooking patois—and then offered up "Chicken Breast and Dumplings," with the "breast" in the title rendered in the red-orange color that indicates a modification.

articles.title: Andrej Karpathy built a curated video platform in a weekend using Claude and 20 years of Hacker News
articles.descEn: OpenAI co-founder Andrej Karpathy used Claude's Opus 5.5 to filter 43 million Hacker News comments into 6,454 curated videos. The result beats YouTube's own recommendations, he says.
articles.titleEn: Andrej Karpathy built a curated video platform in a weekend using Claude and 20 years of Hacker News
summaryLinesEn: Claude filtered 43 million comments from 20 years of Hacker News and distilled them into 6,454 videos that keep getting recommended there .
The site needs no login, shows a single mid-video frame instead of optimized thumbnails, and stores state locally in the browser.
Andrej Karpathy, OpenAI co-founder and current Anthropic AI researcher, built HackerTube over a weekend using Claude's Opus 5.5 model.

articles.title: Don't like Google Health's AI Coach? Here's how to turn it off - Engadget
articles.descEn: If this Premium feature is bugging you, there's good news: you aren't stuck with it.
articles.titleEn: Don't like Google Health's AI Coach? Here's how to turn it off - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Select Your data in Google Health then scroll down to Feature privacy controls and select Manage feature privacy controls .

If you don't like Google Health's AI Coach or need a break from its constant advice, the easiest way to get rid of it is to cancel your Google Health Premium subscription, since AI Coach does not come with the free Google Health tier.

Don't worry, because there is a way to keep Google Health Premium but temporarily (or permanently) set aside the Gemini-powered AI Coach in the app settings thanks to an update released in August 2026.

articles.title: The biggest disadvantages of using AI glasses - Engadget
articles.descEn: Despite the benefit to the disabled and aging communities, smart glasses are problematic when it comes to privacy and safety concerns. Here's what to watch for.
articles.titleEn: The biggest disadvantages of using AI glasses - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: A 2026 survey conducted by Security.org found that 25 percent of respondents reported that they were likely to buy a pair of smart glasses in the coming year.

Some seniors have shown a strong interest in them, adopting the technology for their accessibility features and showing interest in how well they can help one keep track of doctor visits or medication reminders.
If you've spent any amount of time scrolling YouTube or a social media platform that has shorts or reels of some kind, you've likely seen a content creator using smart glasses.

articles.title: I played Android’s first AI frame-gen game: Mobile just had its DLSS moment
articles.descEn: Can AI frame generation make 60 FPS ray tracing viable on phones? We test Arm's NFRU and Unreal's MegaLights in Neural Dawn to see if the illusion holds.
articles.titleEn: I played Android’s first AI frame-gen game: Mobile just had its DLSS moment
summaryLinesEn: Likewise, using upscaling and denoising to quadruple a game’s rendering resolution from 540p to 1080p leaves far more room for smudging, blurring, and other artifacts compared to taking an already healthy 1080p up to 4K.

Neural Dawn was initially locked to a very tight 60 FPS, but once the phone warmed up slightly and hit some more open-ended areas, the frame rate began to fluctuate due to the occasional missed frame.
The OPPO Find X10 Pro Max I played Neural Dawn on costs a whopping £1,799; you could buy three PlayStation 5s for that!

Talk of the mobile silicon town this year is, once again, AI, but this time with a twist for gamers. The latest GPU developments from Arm and Qualcomm center on similar neural upscaling techniques we’ve long seen in the PC space, using “AI” to boost frame rates and resolutions, making next-gen games look and run better without the traditional rendering costs.

In a bid to showcase that this is more than just tech demo talk, Arm worked closely with developer Sumo Digital to create Neural Dawn — a light platforming title built from the ground up to use Unreal Engine’s impressive MegaLights ray-traced lighting system. The game leverages Arm’s Neural Super Sampling and Denoising (NSSD) and Neural Frame Rate Upscaling (NFRU) technologies to make this actually run on a smartphone. Version 1.0 just dropped last week, meaning we can actually go and play it.

articles.title: Suno AI music generator sued again for copyright infringement - Engadget
articles.descEn: Groups that own the music rights to Elvis Presley and Eminem’s tracks filed the latest lawsuits.
articles.titleEn: Suno AI music generator sued again for copyright infringement - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: It recently filed a lawsuit against Anthropic , claiming $41 million in damages for allegedly training its AI models on the musician's works without permission.
New lawsuits are claiming that Suno has once again committed copyright infringement by using Elvis Presley and Eminem's likeness to create AI-generated songs.

As first reported by Variety , a group that owns the rights to Presley's music and Eight Mile Style, a music publishing company that owns hundreds of Eminem recordings, filed separate lawsuits against Suno.

articles.title: Teaching AI to build scientific models
articles.descEn: AI for Science grantees Jakob Macke, Daniel Gedon, and Stefan Wahl on how AI is starting to change how scientific models are built and interpreted.
articles.titleEn: Teaching AI to build scientific models
summaryLinesEn: Hodgkin and Huxley’s approach can be broken down into three steps, and most scientific modeling involves some version of them.
All SBI requires is that you can run the model: put in a set of parameters and get back the kind of data you would expect to see.
Hodgkin and Huxley’s four-particle hypothesis came about because equations involving the fourth power are what you would expect if four separate things all had to happen before a gate could open.

summaryLines: Hodgkin과 Huxley의 접근 방식은 세 단계로 나눌 수 있으며 대부분의 과학적 모델링에는 그 중 일부 버전이 포함됨
SBI가 요구하는 것은 모델을 실행할 수 있다는 것임 · 즉, 일련의 매개변수를 입력하고 예상할 수 있는 종류의 데이터를 가져오는 것임
Hodgkin과 Huxley의 4입자 가설은 문이 열리기 전에 4가지 개별적인 일이 모두 일어나야 한다면 4제곱과 관련된 방정식이 예상되는 것이기 때문에 탄생함

articles.title: OPPO Brings ColorOS 17 to the UAE: Silky Smooth. Flow with AI | OPPO UAE
articles.descEn: OPPO's ColorOS 17 arrives in the UAE, debuting on the Find X10 Series with Living Flow Design, smoother performance and new AI features like AI Mind Pilot.
articles.titleEn: OPPO Brings ColorOS 17 to the UAE: Silky Smooth. Flow with AI | OPPO UAE
summaryLinesEn: With the Laminar Flow Engine, app launch stability improves by 55%, while Gallery thumbnails load up to 50% faster on first launch compared with ColorOS 16.

articles.title: China reportedly recruited AI exec to spy on Jensen Huang
articles.descEn: China’s intelligence agency recruited a businesswoman, Alice Huang, to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, according to The New York Times.
articles.titleEn: China reportedly recruited AI exec to spy on Jensen Huang
summaryLinesEn: Nvidia is investigating Jensen Huang’s relationship with a Chinese spy Apple’s M5 MacBook Air is down to its lowest price since July
China’s intelligence agency recruited Megaspeed executive Alice Huang to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, according to The New York Times .

Last week, the NYT reported that Jensen Huang was seen as the target of a “Chinese spy plot” and shared details about Alice Huang and Jensen Huang’s relationship, but the information that China’s MSS had recruited her is new.

articles.title: GitHub - nano-muse/nanoMuse: nanoMuse: an open-source personal agent for every device you own. One agent with a name and a look of its own that does things, keeps working while the app is closed, remembers you, and asks before anything you cannot undo. On Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows / macOS / Linux and in the browser; your phone's screen and your computer as its hands.

On Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows / macOS / Linux and in the browser; your phone's screen and your computer as its hands.
summaryLinesEn: MobileGym , MemGUI-Bench , PhoneHarness , CopilotKit/OpenMuse , Open-AutoGLM , ClawGUI : the phone operator, the traces and the product ideas. nanoMuse is an independent community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta Platforms, Inc.; Muse is their trademark.

One agent with a name and a look of its own, in the style of Meta's Muse : it does things instead of answering questions, keeps working while the app is closed, remembers you, and stops to ask before anything you could not undo. nano means the whole set, small enough to run and deploy yourself: the phone app, the desktop app, the web console and the relay that joins them are all in this repository, under GPL-3.0-or-later.

Open an issue or send a pull request ; either one helps nanoMuse get better. 2026-10-21 ⭐ 2,000 stars on GitHub and first on GitHub Trending's Swift list ( Trendshift : third on October 20, first on October 21), twenty-six days after the first release.
