articles.descEn: Google AI Educator Series expands to Brazil, Spain, and more. See how teachers use Gemini to save hours on prep and get the details on new training.
articles.titleEn: Expanding AI educator training to new countries
summaryLinesEn: Philippines: Educators are using Gemini to simulate complex market scenarios in economics classes and more, all to free up time for direct student guidance.
We first launched GES in the U.S earlier this year , and later expanded to India , Korea , Malaysia , Philippines, and the U.K & Ireland.

That's why we created the Google AI Educator Series (GES): a no-cost, on-demand training designed to give educators practical AI skills they can use immediately and that fits into their busy schedule.

articles.title: Designing responsible AI for learning
articles.descEn: Google introduces Guided Learning to Search and Classroom to foster critical thinking. Explore these new AI tools and updated school controls. Get the details.
articles.titleEn: Designing responsible AI for learning
summaryLinesEn: Google Classroom: Starting today, Guided Learning is globally available in Google Classroom, a central hub where teachers and students organize schoolwork, share assignments and stay connected.
We’ll share more specifics with schools in the coming months ahead of the changes rolling out so they have time to prepare and enable a smooth transition.
When a student starts a Guided Learning activity assigned by their teacher, it acts like a 1-1 study tool, anchored in class material to help them stay on task.

summaryLinesEn: We’re announcing major updates to our education portfolio: launching Guided Learning into Google Classroom globally, bringing Guided Learning capabilities to Google Search, and updating our approach to controls for Gemini, Gemini Notebook, Gemini in Classroom, and Google Search for K-12 student accounts.
We’re also sharing new research, new Google.org funding, and expanding AI training for educators.
Read our full collection of updates below to learn how we’re building technology purpose-built for education.

articles.title: New research shows how Guided Learning supports students
articles.descEn: New research shows Guided Learning boosts student performance, now available with new teacher controls in Google Classroom. See the study results.
articles.titleEn: New research shows how Guided Learning supports students
summaryLinesEn: Guided Learning is designed to help students work through complex concepts step by step, prioritizing deep understanding over providing direct answers.
New research shows this approach leads to higher learning gains and allows teachers to provide more targeted support.
But students with access to Guided Learning improved by 8.1 percentage points, representing 1.5x higher learning gains in just a single study session.

articles.title: AI Is Changing How Semiconductor Fabs Work — and Engineers Are Moving Faster Because of It
articles.descEn: An AI-defined fab uses accelerated simulation, learned physics models and AI agents to give engineers faster answers across design, testing and manufacturing.
articles.titleEn: AI Is Changing How Semiconductor Fabs Work — and Engineers Are Moving Faster Because of It
summaryLinesEn: Engineers direct the work and make decisions based on their expertise while spending less time waiting for answers.
Using the NVIDIA cuDSS library, multiphysics simulation software provider COMSOL is accelerating such simulations for semiconductor manufacturing by up to 10x.

Together, these capabilities describe an AI-defined fab: a semiconductor manufacturing factory where AI helps engineers optimize processes, catch problems earlier and make better decisions across the full manufacturing chip lifecycle.

articles.title: Building ultra-low-latency voice AI applications on AWS | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how Cartesia, an AWS Partner, uses purpose-built State Space Models and AWS infrastructure to deliver sub-100ms text-to-speech and speech-to-text at global scale, and how to deploy its Sonic model on Amazon SageMaker AI or self-managed Amazon EC2 GPU instances.
articles.titleEn: Building ultra-low-latency voice AI applications on AWS | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Telehealth: Remote patient consultations demand low-latency voice for accurate, empathetic communication.

The demand for real-time voice AI is growing rapidly across industries: Contact centers: AI agents handling millions of customer interactions require instantaneous speech generation to maintain natural dialogue.

Sonic is Cartesia’s flagship streaming text-to-speech model, delivering ultra-realistic speech synthesis with sub-100ms latency: First audio byte in approximately 90ms: Users hear the voice respond almost instantaneously.

summaryLines: 원격 의료 · 원격 환자 상담에는 정확하고 공감적인 의사소통을 위해 지연 시간이 짧은 음성이 필요함
실시간 음성 AI에 대한 수요는 산업 전반에 걸쳐 빠르게 증가하고 있음 · 컨택 센터 · 수백만 건의 고객 상호 작용을 처리하는 AI 에이전트에는 자연스러운 대화를 유지하기 위해 즉각적인 음성 생성이 필요함
Sonic은 Cartesia의 대표적인 스트리밍 텍스트-음성 모델로, 100ms 미만의 대기 시간으로 매우 사실적인 음성 합성을 제공함 · 약 90ms의 첫 번째 오디오 바이트 · 사용자는 음성 응답을 거의 즉각적으로 듣음

articles.title: Build a semantic layer for agentic AI with EDB Postgres AI and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how to build a governed semantic layer for agentic AI inside EDB Postgres AI and query it from a Strands Agents agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Business meaning, join paths, and access control all live in Postgres, with GRANT and row-level security enforcing what each agent can read.
articles.titleEn: Build a semantic layer for agentic AI with EDB Postgres AI and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: An agent that reads it as a unit price and multiplies by quantity returns $502,529 for the top customer instead of $27,991.66.
The Stardog post in this series introduced this framing.

An agent that answers business questions from live data needs three layers: a model that plans and writes queries, a meaning layer that tells the agent what the data represents, and a runtime that hosts the agent and controls identity and access.

articles.title: StateBench: Testing how language models track state changes over long documents
articles.descEn: A Blog post by Ai2 on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: StateBench: Testing how language models track state changes over long documents
summaryLinesEn: We find that recurrent and hybrid models can generalize much farther than transformers when trained directly on these tasks, while frontier models including Gemini 3.8 Flash, Claude Opus 5.5, and GPT-6 Sol and Luna still break down on harder forms of state tracking as inputs grow longer.

However, not all state-tracking problems are created equal: some require only finding the latest update; harder ones require following a chain of changes, where one missed step can throw off the final answer.
The models trained on sequences of up to 256 assignments and were tested on sequences as long as 64,000 assignments, or 250 times the maximum training length.

localization.title: StateBench: 언어 모델이 긴 문서의 상태 변경을 추적하는 방법 테스트
summaryLines: 반복 및 하이브리드 모델은 이러한 작업에 대해 직접 교육을 받을 때 변환기보다 훨씬 더 일반화할 수 있는 반면, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol 및 Luna를 포함한 프론티어 모델은 입력이 길어짐에 따라 여전히 더 어려운 형태의 상태 추적으로 분류됨
그러나 모든 상태 추적 문제가 동일하게 생성되는 것은 아님 · 일부는 최신 업데이트만 찾으면 됨 · 더 어려운 것은 일련의 변경 사항을 따라야 하며, 한 단계를 놓친 경우 최종 답이 사라질 수 있음
모델은 최대 256개의 할당 시퀀스에 대해 훈련되었으며 최대 64,000개의 할당 또는 최대 훈련 길이의 250배에 달하는 시퀀스에 대해 테스트됨

articles.title: Declare and optimize with UNIQUE constraints on Databricks | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Databricks UNIQUE constraints let teams declare multiple nullable or composite uniqueness guarantees beyond a table’s single PRIMARY KEY, and reference them with foreign keys.
articles.titleEn: Declare and optimize with UNIQUE constraints on Databricks | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: In 10 TB TPC-DS benchmarks, UNIQUE with RELY removed over 99.99% of shuffle and delivered up to 12× faster queries.
Databricks already supports PRIMARY KEY and FOREIGN KEY constraints : a primary key identifies a table's rows, and foreign keys can reference it to describe relationships.
UNIQUE constraints, now available in Public Preview for Unity Catalog Delta tables in Databricks SQL and Databricks Runtime 18.2 and above, add a way to record the other uniqueness guarantees.

articles.title: Progress on provable inference for large language models
articles.descEn: Sharing progress on a powerful type of cryptographic proof known as a zkSNARK, which is uniquely fit for provable inference.
articles.titleEn: Progress on provable inference for large language models
summaryLinesEn: 1 This research post is meant to share intermediate progress, and not a completed research agenda.
Our aim is twofold: (i) accelerating and facilitating the development of provable inference; and (ii) demonstrating that zero-knowledge succinct arguments are practical for provable inference.

Specifically, we have made progress on a powerful type of cryptographic proof known as a “zkSNARK”, which is uniquely fit for provable inference (owing to its strong hiding and efficiency properties).

summaryLines: 1 이 연구 게시물은 완성된 연구 안건이 아닌 중간 진행 상황을 공유하기 위한 것임
우리의 목표는 두 가지임 · (i) 증명 가능한 추론의 개발을 가속화하고 촉진함 · (ii) 영지식의 간결한 주장이 증명 가능한 추론에 실용적이라는 것을 입증함
특히, 우리는 (강력한 숨김 및 효율성 특성으로 인해) 증명 가능한 추론에 고유하게 적합한 "zkSNARK"로 알려진 강력한 유형의 암호화 증명에 진전을 이루었음

articles.descEn: Artificial intelligence, once a cool feature living exclusively inside your favorite app, is upgrading. Now, the shift is toward using AI as the foundation and not simply an added feature. AI is now becoming part of operating systems and amping up how we use and interact with devices. The vision: instead of requiring people to […]

summaryLinesEn: The first smartphones shipping with DroiClaw, which currently include devices from Coolpad and Philips, are priced at approximately RMB 1,099 (around US$160).

DroiClaw uses a hybrid architecture that combines on-device AI with cloud-based large language models to support different usage scenarios.

articles.title: Adobe’s Premiere mobile app is adding licensed music from ‘leading artists’
articles.descEn: Adobe is teaming up with Universal Music Group and Warner Music Group to add a library of licensed music clips to the Premiere mobile video editing app.
articles.titleEn: Adobe’s Premiere mobile app is adding licensed music from ‘leading artists’
summaryLinesEn: Adobe is teaming up with Universal Music Group and Warner Music Group to add a library of licensed music clips to the Premiere mobile video editing app.

No specific musicians have been announced with this partnership, but Adobe said it will include “popular songs” from “leading artists,” and enable Premiere mobile users to quickly jump on “the latest trend.”
Adobe says this feature is “coming soon,” and will allow Premiere mobile users to: Add up to 60 seconds of a popular track directly to the video.

articles.title: iOS 27.3 Beta Brings Apple Intelligence to China
articles.descEn: Select Apple Intelligence features are now available in China, with Apple testing the functionality in the iOS 27.3 beta.
articles.titleEn: iOS 27.3 Beta Brings Apple Intelligence to China
summaryLinesEn: Clean Up in Photos for removing unwanted objects from images.

Developers in China can turn on ‌Apple Intelligence‌ after updating to the new software. ‌Apple Intelligence‌ first launched in the United States with iOS 18.1, but Apple was not able to bring it to China until it partnered with Alibaba and won approval from Chinese regulators. ‌Apple Intelligence‌ features like Siri , Writing Tools, and Visual Intelligence integrate Alibaba's Qwen model.
Select Apple Intelligence features are now available in China , with Apple testing the functionality in the iOS 27.3 beta.

articles.title: Runway AI Says ARR Set to Double to $450 Million by End of Year
articles.descEn: Runway AI Inc.’s co-Chief Executive Officer said the startup’s annual recurring revenue is set to hit $450 million by the end of the year, more than double the total in September as demand surges for its video-generation software.
articles.titleEn: Runway AI Says ARR Set to Double to $450 Million by End of Year
summaryLinesEn: Runway AI Inc. ’s co-Chief Executive Officer said the startup’s annual recurring revenue is set to hit $450 million by the end of the year, more than double the total in September as demand surges for its video-generation software.
Runway said it had hit $200 million in ARR two months ago.
Anastasis Germanidis , who is also one of the co-founders of the New York-based company, made the comments at the Bloomberg Tech conference in London.

articles.title: Apple warns of risks related to AI agents behaving in 'unintended or unpredictable' ways
articles.descEn: Apple’s annual filing warns that AI agents could exceed permissions, resist instructions or take actions that are difficult to reverse.
articles.titleEn: Apple warns of risks related to AI agents behaving in 'unintended or unpredictable' ways
summaryLinesEn: Here's why measuring water usage is hard Nintendo Switch 2 sales plunge 41% as price hikes and memory crunch bite Hyperscalers and Apple surge after election results remove investor uncertainty Separately, the ability of agents to use a computer in human ways is forcing big companies like Amazon and JPMorgan Chase to come up with policies around agentic access to services for strategic or security reasons.
Earlier this year, OpenAI released Dots, and Meta introduced Muse.
The new risk factors in Apple's filing show the disruptive potential of AI agents, which have proliferated across the business world.

articles.title: Qualcomm (QCOM) Joins $700 Million Hark Funding Round In AI Assistant Bet
articles.descEn: Qualcomm (NasdaqGS:QCOM) joined Nvidia and AMD in a US$700 million Series A funding round for AI startup Hark, which is valued at US$6b. Hark is working on foundation models, software, and AI-focused hardware aimed at a next generation personal assistant platform. Qualcomm Ventures' participation links the chip designer to Hark's efforts to build AI systems that could reach consumer devices over time. Qualcomm's move into Hark's Series A round sits alongside other shifts in its AI ambitions...

articles.title: 地域交通の持続と進化に向けた構造改革
articles.titleEn: 地域交通の持続と進化に向けた構造改革
summaryLinesEn: Ⅰ はじめに Ⅱ モビリティの地域実証が示す方向性 Ⅲ 標準型先進サービスの普及を阻む地域交通の構造的制約 Ⅳ 制約を解く打開策：地域・事業者・制度の枠を超える Ⅴ 交通サービスが持続・進化する構造への転換 Ⅵ さいごに 急速な人口減少により、競争を前提とした生活インフラサービスの維持が困難となり、特に地方の公共交通は量・質が低下する悪循環に陥っている。
NRIフィナンシャル・グラフィックス 戦略マーケティング部 Tel：03-5789-8251（平日9:30～17:00） Fax：03-5789-8254
打開策として、第1に都道府県とMaaS事業者主導の広域連携によるサービスの標準化、第2にM&Aや共同経営による交通事業者の経営基盤の強化、第3に運行委託のバンドル化・成果連動化や事業許可要件の緩和による先進サービスの参入促進が有効である。

articles.title: 「売り切り製造業」から「人の生活とつながる産業」へ
articles.titleEn: 「売り切り製造業」から「人の生活とつながる産業」へ

articles.title: Claude accelerates protein design and analytical chemistry
articles.descEn: Two results show how Claude helps life sciences researchers speed up their work: designing protein binders from scratch and analyzing NMR and LC-MS data to speed chemical analysis.
articles.titleEn: Claude accelerates protein design and analytical chemistry
summaryLinesEn: The protein design and analytical chemistry tasks described below are representative of the work that makes up some parts of the early stages of the drug development process.

Accelerating these phases is one component of our much larger effort to speed up drug development end-to-end, many aspects of which have more to do with policy and operational bottlenecks than with improvements in core scientific capabilities.
Second, we share how Claude Opus 5 performed on an analytical chemistry task, demonstrating how general-access models can support the routine and time-intensive aspects of research.

localization.title: Claude는 단백질 설계 및 분석 화학을 가속화함
summaryLines: 아래에 설명된 단백질 설계 및 분석 화학 작업은 약물 개발 프로세스의 초기 단계 중 일부를 구성하는 작업을 대표함
이러한 단계를 가속화하는 것은 신약 개발을 전체적으로 가속화하려는 훨씬 더 큰 노력의 한 구성 요소이며, 그 중 많은 측면은 핵심 과학적 역량의 개선보다는 정책 및 운영 병목 현상과 더 관련이 있음
둘째, Claude Opus 5가 분석 화학 작업을 어떻게 수행했는지 공유하여 일반 접근 모델이 연구의 일상적이고 시간 집약적인 측면을 어떻게 지원할 수 있는지 보여줌

articles.title: Claude-shaped science
articles.descEn: Matthew Schwartz describes what happened when he stopped fighting Claude and allowed Claude to find “Claude-shaped” problems. This led him to build BootLoops, a toolkit for exact calculations in quantitative science, which he has been applying across scientific fields alongside experts.
articles.titleEn: Claude-shaped science
summaryLinesEn: Knowing where the amplitude is infinite (its “singularities”) might narrow it to 20,000 options; a symmetry cuts that to 500; and so on down to one.
Matthew Schwartz returns to describe a new approach to AI-accelerated science.
Because similar calculations often turn up across very disparate areas of science, Claude found connections to ecology, population genetics, and a dozen other fields.

articles.title: Vibe physics: The AI grad student
articles.descEn: A Harvard physicist guided Claude Opus 4.5 through a full quantum chromodynamics research project in two weeks.
articles.titleEn: Vibe physics: The AI grad student
summaryLinesEn: A related project, AlphaProof , earned a silver medal at the 2024 International Mathematical Olympiad, solving problems that stumped all but five human contestants, and in 2025, an advanced version of Gemini achieved the gold-medal standard .
And in August 2025, the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) launched the open-source Asta ecosystem, featuring tools like CodeScientist and AutoDiscovery to find patterns in complex datasets.
So I started by asking Claude to come up with a plan of attack: what tasks needed to be done in what order.

articles.descEn: Teams building on Google Cloud can now run production-grade, serverless Postgres directly on the Databricks Data + AI Platform.
articles.titleEn: Lakebase Postgres is now generally available on Google Cloud | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Lakebase is a key component of the Lake Transactional/Analytical Processing (LTAP) architecture which allows organizations to unify their data foundation, decrease operational overhead and lower infrastructure costs.
The result is a Postgres database that scales with your application, shares one governance model with the rest of your data estate, and reduces your total cost of ownership.
Lakebase Postgres, a fully managed, serverless Postgres database, is now generally available on Google Cloud.

articles.title: Key findings from our 2025 enterprise AI adoption report
articles.descEn: Key findings from our 2025 enterprise AI adoption report reveal the benefits and challenges of implementing AI.
articles.titleEn: Key findings from our 2025 enterprise AI adoption report
summaryLinesEn: For our 2025 report, Generative AI adoption in the enterprise, we surveyed a diverse group of 1,600 knowledge workers actively using AI in the workplace — including 800 C-suite executives and 800 employees across the US.

Despite clear benefits, enterprise leaders report division and power struggles from AI adoption While executives are highly optimistic about the future business impact of AI, 42% say the process of adopting generative AI is tearing their company apart.
Enterprises without a formal AI strategy report only 37% success in AI adoption, compared to 80% for those with a strategy.

articles.title: From chaos to control: why enterprises need a new framework for trusted LLMs
articles.descEn: Discover HFS Research’s new framework for trusted, enterprise-grade LLMs and learn how WRITER’s agent supervision suite and Palmyra X5 model help CIOs govern and scale agentic AI safely across the business.
articles.titleEn: From chaos to control: why enterprises need a new framework for trusted LLMs
summaryLinesEn: Today, 75% of knowledge workers use GenAI at work, but only about a third of organizations have formal AI governance in place For CIOs, this creates a familiar and uncomfortable reality: AI enthusiasm is accelerating faster than enterprise readiness.

Our newly introduced agent supervision suite delivers the governance foundation the report calls for — providing centralized visibility into usage and cost, global guardrails for sensitive data, runtime permissions and approvals, and deep integrations with your existing observability and security platforms.
And they need a model where IT can maintain oversight even as business teams accelerate adoption.
articles.summary:

And they need a model where IT can maintain oversight even as business teams accelerate adoption.

sourceContent.headline: From chaos to control: why enterprises need a new framework for trusted LLMs
sourceContent.description: Discover HFS Research’s new framework for trusted, enterprise-grade LLMs and learn how WRITER’s agent supervision suite and Palmyra X5 model help CIOs govern and scale agentic AI safely across the business.
paragraphs: Today, 75% of knowledge workers use GenAI at work, but only about a third of organizations have formal AI governance in place For CIOs, this creates a familiar and uncomfortable reality: AI enthusiasm is accelerating faster than enterprise readiness.

Our newly introduced agent supervision suite delivers the governance foundation the report calls for — providing centralized visibility into usage and cost, global guardrails for sensitive data, runtime permissions and approvals, and deep integrations with your existing observability and security platforms.
And they need a model where IT can maintain oversight even as business teams accelerate adoption.

articles.title: How Arm is redefining the PC ecosystem
articles.descEn: Discover how Arm-based PCs are transforming personal computing through new agentic AI capabilities and a growing native software ecosystem.
articles.titleEn: How Arm is redefining the PC ecosystem
summaryLinesEn: The growth of Arm-based PCs reflects years of investment in silicon innovation, software compatibility, native applications and ecosystem collaboration.
Alongside other Arm-based platforms, this gives device manufacturers and users expanded choice across different performance, efficiency, and workload requirements.
All these developments demonstrate how Arm’s common architecture supports a growing PC ecosystem, spanning different operating systems, silicon platforms, and device categories.

articles.title: How Circle K accelerated DevOps incident triage to under 15 minutes with Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Circle K's DevOps team cut incident triage from 45-60 minutes to under 15 by building an agentic triage system on Amazon Bedrock. This post walks through the architecture, the initial Amazon Bedrock Flows implementation, the migration to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and the lessons learned from scaling it.
articles.titleEn: How Circle K accelerated DevOps incident triage to under 15 minutes with Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Figure 1: Circle K automated incident triage architecture using Amazon Bedrock Flows A Grafana alert: HTTP 5xx error rate on a service exceeds 5% for 3 consecutive minutes.
As the company expanded its digital operations, the triage overhead grew with it.
Since deploying this system, Circle K has reduced mean triage time to under 15 minutes, a 67–75 percent reduction based on the team’s internal incident-response metrics.

articles.title: Build efficient agents with knowledge distillation on Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Agentic assistants built on frontier models run a multi-step tool loop, and paying frontier prices on every step is hard to sustain at production scale. This post shows how to use sequence-level knowledge distillation (SeqKD) to transfer a frontier teacher's agentic behavior into a small, lower-cost student on Amazon SageMaker AI.
articles.titleEn: Build efficient agents with knowledge distillation on Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: It searches the catalog of about 2.7 million products, inspects candidates, and recommends the ones that meet the constraints.
At production scale, that per-task cost compounds, erodes the project’s ROI, and stops the project from shipping.

Knowledge distillation closes that gap by transferring the behavior of the larger “teacher” model into a smaller “student”, training the student to reproduce the teacher’s outputs, so it keeps much of the quality at the smaller model’s speed and cost.

articles.title: Redesigning Agent Studio around Ghostwriter
articles.descEn: We’ve redesigned Agent Studio around Ghostwriter, so you can go from asking why resolution rates dropped to examining the conversations, updating a journey, and testing the fix — all in one conversation.
articles.titleEn: Redesigning Agent Studio around Ghostwriter
summaryLinesEn: Agent Studio now brings related agents into a single project, along with the data and channels they share, so your team can test and release them together.

Ghostwriter is our agent for building agents — an always-on teammate that not only helps you build but also understands how agents are performing, suggests improvements in Slack and Teams, and pushes whatever you approve live.
When the lender adds a new document requirement, Ghostwriter updates what the first agent asks for and how the second one follows up, all in one session.

articles.descEn: How AI-optimized infrastructure turns model innovation into lasting business impact.
articles.titleEn: The Platform Behind the Next AI Breakthrough
summaryLinesEn: Compute must respond to the changing demand of agentic workloads.
They can write and validate code, coordinate across systems, rebalance inventory as conditions change, manage production operations, or carry a migration from plan to completion.
Teams need a complete view of performance, capacity, and cost so they can find bottlenecks and improve the full workload instead of tuning one component at a time.

articles.title: These smart glasses promise to turn your silent mouth movements into text
articles.descEn: Crazy person, or efficient employee? As always, it depends on what they're wearing
articles.titleEn: These smart glasses promise to turn your silent mouth movements into text
summaryLinesEn: Those waves are distorted by muscle movements and the change in a person’s face shape as they speak or simply mouth words, which the duo said can be picked up and translated into written text.
Those interested in finding out can preorder a pair now for $199, with the other $300 not due until the glasses ship.
It’s not clear when they’ll actually be released, though the preorder page says it’ll be sometime in Q1 2027 at an early bird price of $499.

summaryLines: 이러한 파동은 근육 움직임과 사람이 말할 때 얼굴 모양의 변화 또는 단순히 입에서 나오는 말에 의해 왜곡되며, 두 사람이 말한 내용을 포착하여 서면 텍스트로 번역할 수 있음

articles.title: DeepSeek Secures 105.5 Billion Yuan Financing to Expand AI Hardware Partner Network - Ecosystem First, Model Second
articles.descEn: Beyond mere financial support, this initiative represents a strategic collaborative partnership that unites diverse stakeholders, complementary expertise, and shared resources to drive sustainable growth, accelerate innovation, and deliver mutually beneficial outcomes. This integrated teaming model transcends traditional funding arrangements, fostering deep alignment of goals, proactive knowledge exchange, and collective problem-solving capabilities that empower all participating parties to overcome complex market challenges and unlock long-term value far exceeding what isolated financial investment alone could achieve.
articles.titleEn: DeepSeek Secures 105.5 Billion Yuan Financing to Expand AI Hardware Partner Network - Ecosystem First, Model Second
summaryLinesEn: From the perspective of Leikeji (ID: leitech), the 1.055 trillion yuan investment raised by DeepSeek is not only used to purchase computing power and expand model parameters, but also a layout for the future of AI, forming a grand strategy to realize the end-to-end implementation of AI software and hardware.

Recently, foreign media outlet The Information broke a major scoop in China's AI industry: DeepSeek's latest financing round has been expanded to 1.055 trillion RMB, pushing its valuation directly to 6.155 trillion RMB.

Cooperating with vivo and Midea: Seize terminal entrances and increase investment in AI hardware No matter how well the large model performs on the cloud, it ultimately needs to be implemented on terminal devices that ordinary users and families are willing to pay for.

articles.title: New AI-driven Windows malware feeds stolen data to Claude to rank victims’ assets by value, then deletes itself — payload builds custom target assessment, can switch models if one refuses, or skip the AI step entirely
articles.descEn: Stolen Gmail receipts and food-delivery orders feed an AI request for a ‘target assessment’ of each victim.
articles.titleEn: New AI-driven Windows malware feeds stolen data to Claude to rank victims’ assets by value, then deletes itself — payload builds custom target assessment, can switch models if one refuses, or skip the AI step entirely
summaryLinesEn: Already, a Windows malware implant reported in September was built around a panel of up to four LLMs that vote on its next move, and another, reported this week, can fall back to using the victim’s own OpenAI API key.

The target should revoke or rotate all API keys and tokens and change passwords, regardless of exposure; likewise, any funds in a wallet whose seed phrase was stored in plaintext should be moved to a new wallet with a fresh seed, preferably generated on an air-gapped device.
Operating systems need a defensive AI built-in, of course they must be working on this already...

sourceContent.headline: New AI-driven Windows malware feeds stolen data to Claude to rank victims’ assets by value, then deletes itself — payload builds custom target assessment, can switch models if one refuses, or skip the AI step entirely
sourceContent.description: Stolen Gmail receipts and food-delivery orders feed an AI request for a ‘target assessment’ of each victim.
paragraphs: Already, a Windows malware implant reported in September was built around a panel of up to four LLMs that vote on its next move, and another, reported this week, can fall back to using the victim’s own OpenAI API key.

The target should revoke or rotate all API keys and tokens and change passwords, regardless of exposure; likewise, any funds in a wallet whose seed phrase was stored in plaintext should be moved to a new wallet with a fresh seed, preferably generated on an air-gapped device.

articles.title: Enabling independent research on how people use Claude
articles.descEn: Earlier this year, we ran a pilot giving external researchers access to aggregate, real-world Claude usage data. Three research groups designed their own studies for Anthropic Insights, our privacy-preserving analysis tool. In this post, we share high-level results from those studies and what we learned running this pilot.
articles.titleEn: Enabling independent research on how people use Claude
summaryLinesEn: This spring, we piloted a program in which three external research institutions designed and ran their own studies on Claude usage data through Anthropic Insights (formerly named ‘Clio’), the privacy-preserving tool our own teams use to analyze usage patterns across millions of Claude conversations.

It describes how we ran the program, including how we chose our three partners, the research primer we wrote to explain the program’s goals and what Anthropic Insights can do, and how each project moved from proposal to study design to analysis.

We wanted our external partners to have as much independence as possible, so our contractual review rights were limited to user privacy, information that could help people violate our usage policies, Anthropic’s confidential information, and research accuracy.

localization.title: 사람들이 Claude를 어떻게 사용하는지에 대한 독립적인 연구 활성화
summaryLines: 올 봄, 우리 팀은 수백만 건의 Claude 대화에 대한 사용 패턴을 분석하는 데 사용하는 개인 정보 보호 도구인 Anthropic Insights(이전의 'Clio')를 통해 3개의 외부 연구 기관에서 Claude 사용 데이터에 대한 자체 연구를 설계하고 실행하는 프로그램을 시험함
여기에는 세 명의 파트너를 선택한 방법, 프로그램의 목표와 Anthropic Insights가 수행할 수 있는 작업을 설명하기 위해 작성한 연구 입문서, 각 프로젝트가 제안에서 연구 설계, 분석으로 이동한 방법을 포함하여 프로그램을 실행한 방법이 설명되어 있음
우리는 외부 파트너가 가능한 한 많은 독립성을 갖기를 원했기 때문에 계약 검토 권한은 사용자 개인 정보 보호, 사람들이 우리 사용 정책을 위반하는 데 도움이 될 수 있는 정보, Anthropic의 기밀 정보 및 연구 정확성으로 제한됨

articles.title: Lakebase branching for CI/CD: lessons from 100 PR databases | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Snorkel’s CI provisions an ephemeral Kubernetes environment for every open PR and ad-hoc commit, and each namespace greatly benefits from a near-instant access to a full secure copy of the production database with Lakebase branching.
articles.titleEn: Lakebase branching for CI/CD: lessons from 100 PR databases | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: The alternatives (shared staging databases, trimmed fixtures, or synthetic data) bring back the problems production-like testing is supposed to solve: tests interfering with each other, stale schemas, and bugs that only show up with real data shapes.

Snorkel AI's CI/CD pipeline gives every open pull request its own Lakebase Postgres branch, a full read/write copy of production data that's ready in under a minute instead of over 30 minutes or longer, due to which they were never able to enable copy per PR.
Lakebase branches are copy-on-write, so 100 concurrent PR databases on a ~2.5 TB production dataset only add storage for the data each branch changes.

articles.descEn: Ring cameras offer broad capabilities, but third-party AI tools give HOAs, landlords and others even more ways to use them.

summaryLinesEn: It’s $8 per month and it summarizes guest check-outs, cleaner visits, “house rule violations” and more based on what Ring security cameras pick up using AI detection.
They’re also expensive for what they do — such as charging $5 per month just to tell you when your mail arrives — so I don’t think they’re worth the cost for the average user.
But apps such as Pet Vet AI can use Ring cams as an alternative for $10 per month.

articles.title: LiveVoice Reports Adoption of Audio Description and Live Translation Platform Across International Sports Events and Stadiums
articles.descEn: Clemens-Krauss Strasse, SALZBURG, Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- LiveVoice, an Austria-based live audio platform, today reported adoption acr...
articles.titleEn: LiveVoice Reports Adoption of Audio Description and Live Translation Platform Across International Sports Events and Stadiums
summaryLinesEn: 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- LiveVoice, an Austria-based live audio platform, today reported adoption across international sports events and stadiums, where organizers use the platform to deliver audio description, live translation and commentary straight to audiences’ own smartphones.
Organizers set up one channel per language and share access with a QR code or link, and journalists don't need a receiver or headset from the organizer.
Across sports venues, churches, conferences and guided tours, LiveVoice reports more than 5,000 clients, more than 200,000 events and more than 850,000 app downloads in over 100 countries.

articles.title: Nvidia CEO Says Ties to Company Under Spying Probe Were ‘Normal’
articles.descEn: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang said the chipmaker’s dealings with Megaspeed International were “normal and not unusual” following a New York Times report that one of the Singapore firm’s executives is under investigation for spying on behalf of China.
articles.titleEn: Nvidia CEO Says Ties to Company Under Spying Probe Were ‘Normal’
summaryLinesEn: Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang said the chipmaker’s dealings with Megaspeed International were “normal and not unusual” following a New York Times report Bloomberg Terminal that one of the Singapore firm’s executives is under investigation for spying on behalf of China.

Nvidia’s relationship with Megaspeed’s officials was proper, and the chipmaker has checked to ensure that Megaspeed didn’t illegally send its artificial intelligence processors to China, Huang said in an interview Thursday.
That country is barred from buying Nvidia’s powerful AI chips — known as graphics processing units, or GPUs — under US export rules.

localization.title: Nvidia CEO, 스파이 조사를 받고 있는 회사와의 관계는 '정상'이었다고 말함
summaryLines: Jensen Huang 최고경영자(CEO)는 싱가포르 회사의 임원 중 한 명이 중국을 대신해 스파이 행위를 한 혐의로 조사를 받고 있다는 뉴욕타임스의 블룸버그 터미널 보도 이후 칩 제조사와 Megaspeed International과의 거래가 "정상적이고 특이하지 않다"고 말함
황은 목요일 인터뷰에서 엔비디아와 메가스피드 관계자와의 관계가 적절했으며 칩 제조사는 메가스피드가 자사의 인공 지능 프로세서를 중국에 불법적으로 보내지 않았는지 확인했다고 말함
해당 국가는 미국 수출 규정에 따라 그래픽 처리 장치(GPU)로 알려진 엔비디아의 강력한 AI 칩을 구매하는 것이 금지되어 있음

articles.descEn: Chargeback Gurus CEO Tim Tynan shares how proprietary technology and expert human oversight are helping enterprise brands adapt to evolving fraud vectors.
articles.titleEn: AI, Agentic Commerce and the New Rules of Chargeback Management
summaryLinesEn: Mastercard sponsored some research by Datos Insights that projects global chargeback volume will grow 24 percent by 2028.
What major forces—from evolving consumer behavior to shifting card network rules—are making chargeback management uniquely complex for merchants right now?

SJ: Looking ahead at emerging trends like agentic commerce and changing network rules, how should merchants adapt their risk strategies—and how is Chargeback Gurus evolving to keep them ahead of future fraud vectors?

summaryLinesEn: This post also catches up on the Search REST API , which changed a lot over the 1.39 patch line.

articles.title: Stripe on Stripe: What we learned moving $1B in vendor payments to Global Payouts
articles.descEn: In early 2026, we began moving our vendor payments to Global Payouts, Stripe’s product for paying recipients in 160+ countries. New-market setup fell from six weeks to one, with a 99.9% payout success rate. Here’s what we learned.
articles.titleEn: Stripe on Stripe: What we learned moving $1B in vendor payments to Global Payouts
summaryLinesEn: By October 2026, we had paid over $1 billion to more than 3,400 vendors in the US and UK using Global Payouts.
Once we identified the most common reasons for failure, we moved those checks earlier in the payment flow.
Earlier this year, we began moving Stripe’s own vendor payments to the product we were building to help our users send money around the world: Stripe Global Payouts .

articles.title: 「不安なのに、何もしていない」住まい・暮らし方にみる生活者の防犯意識
articles.titleEn: 「不安なのに、何もしていない」住まい・暮らし方にみる生活者の防犯意識
summaryLinesEn: 防犯に不安を感じている層は44.4%に達する一方、自主的な防犯対策を「特に何もしていない」は54.3%と半数を超える。
持ち家（一戸建て）では不安層が54.7%と半数を超える一方、持ち家（マンションなど集合住宅）では30.5%にとどまり、「あまり＋まったく不安を感じていない」（43.8%）を下回る。
また、共働きなどで「ほぼ毎日（週5回以上）」留守になる層では33.1%と、在宅者のいる留守が「ほとんどない」層（28.6%）よりやや高い。
articles.summary:
防犯に不安を感じている層は44.4%に達する一方、自主的な防犯対策を「特に何もしていない」は54.3%と半数を超える。
持ち家（一戸建て）では不安層が54.7%と半数を超える一方、持ち家（マンションなど集合住宅）では30.5%にとどまり、「あまり＋まったく不安を感じていない」（43.8%）を下回る。
また、共働きなどで「ほぼ毎日（週5回以上）」留守になる層では33.1%と、在宅者のいる留守が「ほとんどない」層（28.6%）よりやや高い。

articles.title: How Deaconess psychiatric nurse practitioner uses context-aware decision support
articles.descEn: Learn how nurse practitioner Olivia Taylor at Deaconess Health is using Abridge's context-aware decision support in her practice.
articles.titleEn: How Deaconess psychiatric nurse practitioner uses context-aware decision support
summaryLinesEn: We sat down with Olivia Taylor, a psychiatric mental health nurse practitioner at Deaconess Health with a decade of experience across both inpatient and outpatient care.
And if you're curious how Abridge's context-aware decision support could fit into your workflow, head to the CDS page on our website to learn more.
It's made me noticeably more efficient, without giving up the evidence-based care I pride myself in using.

articles.descEn: Learn how emergency medicine clinician Dr. Brian Dilcher at West Virginia University Medicine uses Abridge's context-aware decision support.
articles.titleEn: How WVU Emergency Medicine Clinician Uses Context-Aware Decision Support
summaryLinesEn: How does it hold up in an environment as fast-moving as the ED?
I work mostly in the adult ED, with a shift or two a quarter in the pediatric ED.
In high-pressure care settings like the emergency department, time and information are everything, but in scarce supply.

articles.title: Our customers’ ambition is accelerating our growth
articles.descEn: We launched Sierra just over two and a half years ago. This week, we hit $400M+ in ARR, adding $150M+ in ARR in Q3 alone. That’s more ARR in one quarter than we generated all of last year.
articles.titleEn: Our customers’ ambition is accelerating our growth
summaryLinesEn: This week, we hit $400M+ in ARR, adding over $150M+ in ARR in Q3 alone.
More importantly, our growth is accelerating: we took six months to double from $100M to $200M ARR, and only five months to double from $200M to $400M.

This growth is driven by a number of different factors, including: The increasing ambition of our customers — while being some of the largest and most heavily regulated businesses in the world, they’re pushing to do more with their agents, faster.

articles.title: Scaling Managed Agents with stable interfaces
articles.descEn: Harnesses encode assumptions that go stale as models improve. See how Managed Agents is built around interfaces that stay stable as harnesses change.
articles.titleEn: Scaling Managed Agents with stable interfaces
summaryLinesEn: As just one example, in prior work we found that Claude Sonnet 4.5 would wrap up tasks prematurely as it sensed its context limit approaching—a behavior sometimes called “context anxiety.”
Meta-harness design means being opinionated about the interfaces around Claude: we expect that Claude will need the ability to manipulate state (the session) and perform computation (the sandbox).
For each brain, no inference could happen until that container was provisioned; every session paid the full container setup cost up front.

articles.title: We’ve received our first response from the Project Suncatcher prototype satellite.
articles.descEn: This week, we reached our "Hello World" milestone: the first-ever AI response from a data center class TPU in orbit.
articles.titleEn: We’ve received our first response from the Project Suncatcher prototype satellite.
summaryLinesEn: This week, we reached our "Hello World" milestone: the first-ever AI response from a data center class TPU in orbit.
On October 1, we launched our prototype satellite for Project Suncatcher.
Since then, we've spent the last few weeks completing our commissioning checklist, which included powering up the host and TPU trays and successfully running early machine learning tests.

articles.title: Configure the ChatGPT desktop app with Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US) | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: The ChatGPT desktop app is now available on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US). This post walks through a controlled local deployment that routes model inference to Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US-West) using API-mode sign-in, a managed device policy, a named AWS profile, and network restrictions, so a security team can validate it before broader use.
articles.titleEn: Configure the ChatGPT desktop app with Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US) | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The configuration has three main steps: set up authentication, set up the ChatGPT desktop app configuration files, and then launch, initialize, and verify the deployment.
If it opens automatically or if the app has been launched previously, fully exit ChatGPT and end any lingering ChatGPT or Codex processes.
Before setting up the ChatGPT desktop app with AWS GovCloud (US), make sure your version of the ChatGPT desktop app supports Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US).

articles.title: How Worldwide Express automated freight exceptions with Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Worldwide Express automated its less-than-truckload freight billing-exception process with a multi-agent solution built on Amazon Bedrock. Six months after launch, the company cut active exceptions by 75%, improved time-to-cash by four weeks, and unlocked $10 million in free cash flow.
articles.titleEn: How Worldwide Express automated freight exceptions with Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Worldwide Express (part of ShipStation Global) had built something big: approximately $5 billion in systemwide revenue, over 75 less-than-truckload (LTL) carriers and more than 130,000 customers.
Knowing the business value of exceptions automation, Worldwide Express moved from assessment to production in less than 6 months.
Worldwide Express unlocked $10M in freed-up cash flow, over $1M in annual cost savings, and 60x first-year ROI.

articles.descEn: A Blog post by NVIDIA on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: nemotron-halloween
summaryLinesEn: TL;DR: MonsterHouse is an interactive projection I created for Halloween.

If it’s not obvious by now, I work at NVIDIA and due to this I was able to test Bolt E4B before its public release and found it to be a solid choice, with a smaller footprint than other frontrunners- Qwen3 30B-A3B and Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B.
Next down the pipe is Audio2Face-3D and the 3d character scene I created in Epic’s Unreal Engine.

articles.title: Calling new grads: APX year 2
articles.descEn: Are you a college senior or recent graduate? If you’re driven to turn AI theory into practice, make an impact, and learn from some of the best in our industry, we’d love to build with you.
articles.titleEn: Calling new grads: APX year 2
summaryLinesEn: It’s less than two years since Sierra launched our first agents, and we can both safely say building agents is the single best way to get broad-based product experience today.
But you will learn so much about AI, how to build and launch products, and what it means to partner with some of the world’s most successful businesses.
Most important of all, you’ll have the opportunity to make an impact — improving the consumer experience for millions of people globally.

localization.title: 새로운 졸업생 부르기 · APX 2년차
summaryLines: Sierra가 첫 번째 에이전트를 출시한 지 2년이 채 되지 않았으며, 우리 둘 다 오늘날 에이전트 구축이 광범위한 제품 경험을 얻을 수 있는 가장 좋은 방법이라고 안전하게 말할 수 있음
그러나 AI, 제품 구축 및 출시 방법, 세계에서 가장 성공적인 비즈니스와 파트너십을 맺는 것이 무엇을 의미하는지에 대해 많은 것을 배우게 됨
무엇보다도 가장 중요한 것은 전 세계 수백만 명의 소비자 경험을 개선하여 영향력을 행사할 수 있는 기회를 갖게 된다는 것임

articles.title: Preview web apps live as your coding agent builds them with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime | Amazon Web Services

In this post, you deploy a coding agent that keeps a Vite website running in its session, then watch the live site update in your browser as the agent edits files.
articles.titleEn: Preview web apps live as your coding agent builds them with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime | Amazon Web Services

articles.title: This electric screwdriver uses a camera and AI to figure out what bit you need
articles.descEn: The Arrowspace S1 electric screwdriver has a camera on the end so a built-in AI model can figure out exactly which bit you need to tighten or loosen a screw.
articles.titleEn: This electric screwdriver uses a camera and AI to figure out what bit you need
summaryLinesEn: The Arrowspace S1 features a 600mAh rechargeable battery the company claims delivers enough power to run for up to 90 minutes, or tighten or loosen over 900 screws.
You can preorder the screwdriver by itself for around $79, but its functionality and usefulness is expanded by bundling it with the S1 smart bit case that bumps the preorder price to around $129.

To save you the trouble of having to find the exact bit that’s needed, the optional S1 Smart Case has a collection of 52 steel bits with an LED next to each one that lights up so the one you need is easy to spot.

articles.title: Cisco chief found a 27-year-old ex-founder ‘buried away in the organization doing something unstrategic’—now he's upgrading 98% of its code | Fortune
articles.descEn: Meet Paddy, the 27-year-old Cisco’s president calls an “energizer bunny.” He’s been given unlimited AI tokens and told to “go nuts.”
articles.titleEn: Cisco chief found a 27-year-old ex-founder ‘buried away in the organization doing something unstrategic’—now he's upgrading 98% of its code | Fortune
summaryLinesEn: He joined Cisco in 2025 after the $429 billion tech giant acquired EzDubs , the real-time translation startup Krishnamurthy cofounded in 2023.
“The only way for us to keep accelerating is to make sure we’re surrounded by people with a broad range of experience,” he said.

Entry-level jobs are vanishing ; some 40% of bosses say they plan to hire fewer grads because AI can do the job cheaper, and young workers are routinely slammed for showing up late and refusing to put in overtime for free .

articles.title: ASE Technology Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on AI-Driven LEAP Growth
articles.descEn: ASX beats Q3 earnings estimates as AI-driven LEAP demand fuels revenue growth, expands margins and prompts a higher 2026 outlook.
articles.titleEn: ASE Technology Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on AI-Driven LEAP Growth
summaryLinesEn: ASE Technology Holding ASX reported third-quarter 2026 earnings of 37 cents per ADS, which increased 125.3% year over year and beat the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 8.8%.
In U.S. dollar terms, revenues of $7.64 billion surpassed the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 3.3%.
Gross margin expanded 500 basis points to 22.1%, reflecting stronger ATM revenues, favorable LEAP product mix and currency benefits.
articles.summary:
ASE Technology Holding ASX reported third-quarter 2026 earnings of 37 cents per ADS, which increased 125.3% year over year and beat the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 8.8%.
In U.S. dollar terms, revenues of $7.64 billion surpassed the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 3.3%.
Gross margin expanded 500 basis points to 22.1%, reflecting stronger ATM revenues, favorable LEAP product mix and currency benefits.

articles.title: Intel's AI Business Grew 78%. So Why Did the Stock Just Crash 30%?
articles.descEn: Intel stock fell 29% after weak Q4 guidance wiped out a 78% AI revenue jump. Here is what sank the forecast.
articles.titleEn: Intel's AI Business Grew 78%. So Why Did the Stock Just Crash 30%?
summaryLinesEn: Hours earlier, Intel had reported that its data center and AI business grew 78%, its fastest pace in 15 years.
The cost of insuring Intel's debt against default for five years jumped to a record 123.5 basis points on Friday, its biggest one-day move since October 2022, according to Markit data.
Intel started 2026 at $39.38, according to Yahoo Finance data, so even at $67 the stock is up about 65% this year.

summaryLinesEn: “Other labs have raised hundreds of billions to develop equivalent capabilities; in three years, Mistral raised roughly $6 billion.”
Open weights mean companies can take the model and deploy it on their own hardware, within their own firewalls, and run sensitive data without exposing it to the cloud or outside parties.

articles.title: I Gave My Blood to the AI Death Clock
articles.descEn: Death Clock promises to predict when you’re going to die and help you extend your time on Earth. After a month, I felt like it was sucking the life out of me.
articles.titleEn: I Gave My Blood to the AI Death Clock
summaryLinesEn: For a $69 subscription, you can get a basic blood panel that measures things like cholesterol, blood sugars, inflammation, vitamin D, and blood and organ health.
All of which led me to Death Clock, an app launched in 2024 aimed at tracking users’ health habits in an attempt to prolong their lives.
There are also nine additional tests—assessing everything from hormones and micronutrients to your thyroid—that, altogether, cost $780.

articles.title: Mistral Says Its AI Model ‘Le Chonk’ Has Leapfrogged China in the Open-Weight Race
articles.descEn: The French AI lab claims its latest release matches or outperforms even the best models from DeepSeek and Z.ai in coding and cybersecurity.
articles.titleEn: Mistral Says Its AI Model ‘Le Chonk’ Has Leapfrogged China in the Open-Weight Race
summaryLinesEn: If AI is destined to become a central feature of both cyber offense and defense, the argument goes, businesses and governments will need to be equipped with models that are freely available and cannot be switched off remotely, unlike proprietary models from the likes of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.
At the time, the company said it was the most advanced open-weight offering outside of China.
After further refinement, Mistral now says Le Chonk is the “world’s best” open-weight model for automated coding and cybersecurity.

articles.title: Google's AI search problem finally shows up in the earnings report, some investors believe
articles.descEn: Google's stock dropped as much as ten percent after its quarterly earnings. Cloud revenue more than doubled to $30.7 billion, but search revenue grew just 12 percent, slower than expected. Google acknowledged that its fast-growing AI mode brings in less revenue than traditional search, and it is now expanding its AI mode ad program internationally.
articles.titleEn: Google's AI search problem finally shows up in the earnings report, some investors believe
summaryLinesEn: Google is doubling down on AI buildout: capital spending hit $51.4 billion in the third quarter alone, and the company expects it to "increase significantly" in 2027.
Google lost up to ten percent of its market value because an old investor fear appears to be coming true.
Google's stock dropped as much as ten percent after search revenue grew just 12 percent in the third quarter, missing the 15 percent analysts had expected.

articles.title: We urgently need to monitor AI agents’ actions in real time
articles.descEn: Right now, we’re effectively flying blind when deploying these tools. Here’s what we need to do instead.
articles.titleEn: We urgently need to monitor AI agents’ actions in real time
summaryLinesEn: The “what happened” records identify the agent (while preserving privacy) and log how humans intervened and whether agent permissions or “memory” shifted, while the “decision” records show an agent’s reasoning and levels of confidence in the actions it’s taken.
And as our recent research shows, current agent frameworks—the software that runs agents— do not reliably generate the crucial observability records we need to ensure that agents are deployed safely.

And while safety depends on monitoring, monitoring requires observability : the capacity to capture what the system did, process it into signals, and present those to humans or automated oversight systems.

articles.title: Microsoft’s AI future has fewer jobs
articles.descEn: It’s also time to name the next Elder Scrolls game, and Xbox’s architect of Forza Motorsport is leaving.
articles.titleEn: Microsoft’s AI future has fewer jobs
summaryLinesEn: This week’s voluntary exit offer arrived just months after Microsoft laid off 4,800 employees , cuts that impacted its Xbox and commercial sales teams the most.
How Nadella handles that transition will define his legacy as much as the growth and success he’s achieved over the past decade.

“Our total people costs will go down, our cost per head will go up, and my GPU per researcher will go up,” Nadella said on a podcast almost two years ago, responding to a question about AI’s impact on headcount.

summaryLines: 이번 주 자발적 퇴직 제안은 Microsoft가 4,800명의 직원을 해고한 지 불과 몇 달 만에 이루어졌으며, 이는 Xbox 및 상업 판매 팀에 가장 큰 영향을 미쳤음
Nadella가 이러한 전환을 처리하는 방법은 그가 지난 10년 동안 달성한 성장과 성공만큼이나 그의 유산을 정의할 것임
Nadella는 거의 2년 전 팟캐스트에서 AI가 인원 수에 미치는 영향에 대한 질문에 답하면서 "총 인력 비용은 줄어들고, 1인당 비용은 올라가고, 연구원당 GPU는 올라갈 것임" · 라고 말함

Like image support in AnyLanguageModel, this goes beyond what Apple's API offers today.

articles.title: Announcing Project ProtoStar: Making Publicly Funded Science AI-Ready
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: Announcing Project ProtoStar: Making Publicly Funded Science AI-Ready
summaryLinesEn: Today, we're announcing Project ProtoStar , an initiative to unlock the potential of publicly funded scientific research by making datasets, models, and code more accessible and reusable, particularly for AI-driven research.

Project ProtoStar aims to help close this gap by encouraging systematic sharing of publicly funded scientific artifacts in AI-ready formats, supported by open infrastructure and practical publishing guidance.
The resulting projects and lessons learned will help build a practical evidence base for making publicly funded science more accessible and useful.

summaryLines: 오늘 우리는 특히 AI 기반 연구를 위해 데이터 세트, 모델 및 코드의 접근성과 재사용성을 높여 공공 자금 지원을 받는 과학 연구의 잠재력을 활용하기 위한 이니셔티브인 Project ProtoStar를 발표함

결과적으로 얻은 프로젝트와 교훈은 공적 자금을 지원받는 과학을 더욱 접근 가능하고 유용하게 만들기 위한 실질적인 증거 기반을 구축하는 데 도움이 될 것임

articles.title: How Procore is powering construction analytics with OpenSharing | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: How Procore uses Databricks OpenSharing to share hundreds of governed tables with construction companies and lift the once-a-day refresh ceiling so customers can refresh hourly.
articles.titleEn: How Procore is powering construction analytics with OpenSharing | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: When a project manager, a construction executive thousands of miles away, and a superintendent on the jobsite can't see the same view of a project, decisions get made based on stale or partial information.

Doubled data availability for end customers and internal product teams, accelerating new product experiences and giving real estate facility owners, general contractors, and specialty contractors a single trusted view of every job.

Customers also need that data in their own environments, alongside everything else they run the business on (e.g. a general contractor pulling Procore data into Power BI to track workforce and personnel metrics across active jobs, or a customer joining it with their ERP and financial systems to see project execution and cost in one place).

summaryLines: 프로젝트 관리자, 수천 마일 떨어진 건설 임원, 작업 현장의 감독관이 프로젝트에 대한 동일한 보기를 볼 수 없으면 오래되거나 부분적인 정보를 기반으로 결정이 내려짐
최종 고객과 내부 제품 팀의 데이터 가용성을 두 배로 높이고, 새로운 제품 경험을 가속화하고, 부동산 시설 소유자, 일반 계약자, 전문 계약자에게 모든 작업에 대한 신뢰할 수 있는 단일 보기를 제공함
또한 고객은 비즈니스를 운영하는 다른 모든 것과 함께 자신의 환경에서 해당 데이터가 필요합니다(예 · 일반 계약업체가 Procore 데이터를 Power BI로 가져와 활성 작업 전반에 걸쳐 인력 및 인사 지표를 추적하거나 고객이 ERP 및 재무 시스템과 결합하여 프로젝트 실행 및 비용을 한 곳에서 확인하는 경우)

articles.title: Partnering with Singapore to bring frontier AI to public health
articles.descEn: Google is opening a new research hub in Singapore to deploy MedGemma and AI tools for clinicians. See how we are advancing healthcare innovation.
articles.titleEn: Partnering with Singapore to bring frontier AI to public health
summaryLinesEn: To advance scientific research, Google.org and Google DeepMind are contributing $7 million to the Philanthropy Asia Alliance’s Health for Human Potential Coalition.
Accelerating scientific breakthroughs and local research We’re establishing a Google Research hub in Singapore composed of local research scientists and software engineers.

This includes $1 million for PathGen , an AI platform that uses Google technology to help countries detect disease threats faster and share data for public health intelligence while protecting in-country data sovereignty.

articles.title: How Gemini is helping students and teachers in the classroom
articles.descEn: New studies show Gemini tutoring matches human performance and helps teachers boost student engagement. Read the full research report.
articles.titleEn: How Gemini is helping students and teachers in the classroom
summaryLinesEn: Dive into new topics with immersive explorations in the Gemini app. 15 college students share their favorite Gemini features We’re sharing 3 tips to study smarter with Gemini Notebook.

When educators used Gemini to co-design lessons, they reported feeling more creative than usual in their teaching and planning (79% with Gemini vs. 30% without Gemini) — a shift that helped transform classroom dynamics.

Together, we learned from Primary, Secondary and Vocational educators across 1,600 teachers (representing over 24,500 students ages 13-18) by collecting classroom activities and self reports on lesson planning both with and without Gemini for Education to understand how AI supports classroom dynamics, student engagement, and teacher wellbeing.

localization.title: Gemini가 교실에서 학생과 교사를 돕는 방법
summaryLines: Gemini 앱의 몰입형 탐색을 통해 새로운 주제에 대해 알아보세요 · 15명의 대학생이 자신이 가장 좋아하는 Gemini 기능을 공유함 · Gemini Notebook을 사용하여 더욱 스마트하게 공부할 수 있는 3가지 팁을 공유함
교육자들이 Gemini를 사용하여 수업을 공동 설계했을 때 교육 및 계획에서 평소보다 더 창의적이라고 느꼈습니다(Gemini 사용 시 79%, Gemini 사용 안 함 30%) · 이는 교실 역학을 변화시키는 데 도움이 되는 변화였음
우리는 1,600명의 교사(13~18세 학생 24,500명 이상 대표)의 초등, 중등 및 직업 교육자들로부터 AI가 교실 역학, 학생 참여 및 교사 복지를 어떻게 지원하는지 이해하기 위해 Gemini for Education 유무에 관계없이 수업 계획에 대한 교실 활동과 자체 보고서를 수집하여 배웠음

articles.descEn: Earn 5.0 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits™ with the new Google AI for Healthcare Professionals Certificate. Streamline administrative tasks and register now.
articles.titleEn: Equipping healthcare professionals with practical AI skills
summaryLinesEn: The Google AI for Healthcare Professionals Certificate offers an opportunity to build these skills, while earning up to 5.0 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits™.

articles.title: Granite Switch 4.1.1 — Update models like you update software
articles.descEn: A Blog post by IBM Granite on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: Granite Switch 4.1.1 — Update models like you update software
summaryLinesEn: Live speech, heard and sized up by one Granite Switch model

Just over a week ago, we released Granite Switch 4.1 , showing that our modular Switch architecture lets you configure a language model with specialized, cache-efficient adapters — adding new expertise on a single endpoint.
The version number means what it means in software: fully backwards compatible with 4.1, no migration, incremental improvements under the hood.

articles.title: Americans Are Open to AI in Healthcare, but Want Humans Making Final Calls
articles.descEn: Americans are open to AI for tasks that range from scheduling to diagnoses, but they generally want human review.
articles.titleEn: Americans Are Open to AI in Healthcare, but Want Humans Making Final Calls
summaryLinesEn: A majority (60%) is uncomfortable with AI being used for healthcare tasks like diagnoses and treatments, double the share who says they’re comfortable (30%).
This builds on our previous research looking at AI’s impact on healthcare and health information.

For example, 65% of Asian adults are open to AI playing some role in decisions on health insurance claims, significantly higher than the shares of White (40%), Hispanic (45%) and Black Americans (39%) who are receptive.

summaryLines: 대다수(60%)는 AI가 진단 및 치료와 같은 의료 업무에 사용되는 것을 불편해하며, 편안하다고 답한 비율(30%)의 두 배임
이는 AI가 의료 및 건강 정보에 미치는 영향을 조사한 이전 연구를 기반으로 함
예를 들어, 아시아 성인의 65%는 AI가 건강 보험 청구 결정에 어떤 역할을 하는 것에 대해 개방적이며, 이는 수용적인 백인(40%), 히스패닉(45%) 및 흑인(39%)의 비율보다 훨씬 높음

articles.title: The 2026 Midterms Will Be Uniquely Difficult for Polls
articles.descEn: Polls haven't gotten worse, but fake respondents, synthetic AI surveys and election unknowns make the 2026 midterms uniquely hard to poll.
articles.titleEn: The 2026 Midterms Will Be Uniquely Difficult for Polls
summaryLinesEn: And yet, many consumers expect a level of precision that polls can’t deliver.
At the same time, the rapid increase in the cost of high-quality polling has led to fewer of these polls, relative to cheaper opt-in polls.

Meanwhile, predicting who will show up to vote keeps getting harder as voting rules (when, where and how to vote) change over time and across jurisdictions, and as microtargeting by campaigns can move segments of the electorate in ways broad polls often can’t register.

localization.title: 2026년 중간고사는 여론조사에서 유난히 어려울 것임
summaryLines: 그럼에도 불구하고 많은 소비자들은 여론조사가 제공할 수 없는 수준의 정확성을 기대함
동시에, 고품질 여론조사 비용의 급격한 증가로 인해 저렴한 사전 조사에 비해 이러한 여론조사 수가 줄어들었음
한편, 투표 규칙(투표 시기, 장소, 방법)이 시간이 지남에 따라 관할 구역에 따라 변경되고 캠페인을 통한 마이크로 타겟팅이 광범위한 여론 조사에서 종종 등록할 수 없는 방식으로 유권자의 세그먼트를 이동할 수 있기 때문에 누가 투표에 나타날지 예측하는 것이 점점 더 어려워지고 있음

우리의 임베디드 금융 시장 조사는 이러한 성장의 주요 동인과 이것이 은행, 결제 제공업체, 전자상거래 플랫폼, 인프라 제공업체, 규제 기관 및 기술 공급업체 등 이 시장의 이해관계자에게 의미하는 바에 대한 자세한 분석을 제공함

articles.descEn: Learn how Azure Cloud HSM gives customers an additional layer of evidence for understanding administrative activity and validating records.
articles.titleEn: Azure Cloud HSM Hardware Audit Logging: Verifiable audit trails for security and compliance | Microsoft Azure Blog
summaryLinesEn: Azure Cloud HSM Hardware Audit Logging: Verifiable audit trails for security and compliance Organizations running regulated and security-sensitive workloads need trusted evidence of which authenticated users performed management operations on their hardware security modules (HSMs), what actions they took, and when.

Monitor HSM management operations with hardware-generated audit logs Hardware Audit Logging captures a broad range of HSM management activities, including: Together, these events help organizations build a more complete view of how the HSM is being operated.
Today, we are announcing Hardware Audit Logging for Azure Cloud HSM , which collects audit records generated by the HSM itself for supported management operations.

localization.title: Azure Cloud HSM 하드웨어 감사 로깅 · 보안 및 규정 준수에 대한 검증 가능한 감사 추적 | 마이크로소프트 애저 블로그
summaryLines: Azure Cloud HSM 하드웨어 감사 로깅 · 보안 및 규정 준수를 위한 검증 가능한 감사 추적 규제되고 보안에 민감한 워크로드를 실행하는 조직에는 인증된 사용자가 HSM(하드웨어 보안 모듈)에서 관리 작업을 수행했는지, 어떤 조치를 취했는지, 언제 수행했는지에 대한 신뢰할 수 있는 증거가 필요함
하드웨어 생성 감사 로그를 사용하여 HSM 관리 작업을 모니터링함 · 하드웨어 감사 로깅은 다음을 포함한 광범위한 HSM 관리 활동을 캡처함 · 이러한 이벤트는 조직이 HSM이 작동되는 방식에 대한 보다 완전한 보기를 구축하는 데 도움이 됨
오늘 우리는 지원되는 관리 작업을 위해 HSM 자체에서 생성된 감사 레코드를 수집하는 Azure Cloud HSM용 하드웨어 감사 로깅을 발표함

articles.title: Colorado students joined a Google hackathon to tackle energy grid challenges.
articles.descEn: Students at the Google Colorado Impact Hackathon built AI tools like SolarSnap to modernize the energy grid. See the winning innovations here.
articles.titleEn: Colorado students joined a Google hackathon to tackle energy grid challenges.
summaryLinesEn: Brin Enterkin (Impact Hackathon Lead @ Google), Megan Christensen (State of Colorado Energy Office), Phil Weiser (Colorado Attorney General), Erick Mueller (CU Head of Entrepreneurship & Innovation), Betsy Klein (Associate Director of CU Deming Center for Entrepreneurship), Beth Hartmen (Director of CU External Engagement in Sustainability) Colorado Attorney General Phil Weiser and Brin Enterkin pause for a quick selfie after his closing keynote.

The winning projects addressed this head on: First place: SolarSnap , an AI app that helps homeowners find the ideal setup for solar panels using their phone’s camera Second place: Grid Watch , an AI-managed battery network designed to keep power on during wildfire shutoffs while reducing electricity costs.
We held the second annual Colorado Impact Hackathon at our Boulder offices, in partnership with CU Boulder and the Colorado Energy Office.

articles.title: Accelerate agentic AI with NVIDIA Nemotron models on Amazon EKS and SageMaker HyperPod EKS | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is a 120B-parameter mixture-of-experts model that pairs reasoning and tool use with multimodal understanding. This post explores its architecture and use cases, then shows how to deploy it on Amazon EKS, EKS Auto Mode, and Amazon SageMaker HyperPod EKS with NVIDIA Dynamo and vLLM.
articles.titleEn: Accelerate agentic AI with NVIDIA Nemotron models on Amazon EKS and SageMaker HyperPod EKS | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: NVIDIA reports 63.44 percent on Hermes Bench and 87.05 percent on LangChain agent evaluations, and 80.8 percent on the CharXiv chart-reasoning benchmark. ( technical report ) Nemotron 3.5 Super VL uses a hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE architecture, interleaving Mamba-2, attention, and expert layers.
Nemotron 3.5 Super VL supports agent workflows that combine reasoning with visual understanding: Coding: test and validate code, analyze errors, recommend fixes.
NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL joins the NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano , Nano Omni , Super , Ultra , and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning models already available on AWS.

articles.title: You can now generate, preview, and edit documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, and more directly in Gemini.
articles.descEn: Generate, edit, and preview PDFs or Docs directly in Gemini. Use the new full-screen editor to refine your files today. See what's new in Gemini.
articles.titleEn: You can now generate, preview, and edit documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, and more directly in Gemini.
summaryLinesEn: We’re introducing new ways to create and refine documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, code, and more in the Gemini app.
You can now generate, preview, and edit files right within your chat — expand to full screen to type edits directly, highlight text to ask questions, or have Gemini refine your files.

As shown in the video below, you can now ask Gemini to create a PDF study guide from your uploaded handwritten lecture notes and then you can easily manually edit, highlight specific sections to have Gemini make edits to text or visuals, and even ask further questions.

articles.title: On Facebook and Instagram, Political Ads Are Increasingly Critical of Data Centers
articles.descEn: Political ads about data centers on Facebook and Instagram have turned increasingly critical, with 57% opposed and just 3% supportive ahead of the midterms.
articles.titleEn: On Facebook and Instagram, Political Ads Are Increasingly Critical of Data Centers
summaryLinesEn: Over a period of 90 days from Jul. 27 to Oct. 24, advertisers on Facebook and Instagram spent almost $12 million on ads that mention data centers in the context of social issues, elections or politics .
The remaining 39% of recent spending has been for ads that support specific candidates.
Since late July, advertisers spent more than $1 million on political ads mentioning data centers that targeted Facebook and Instagram users in each of three states – Ohio, Wisconsin and Texas.

articles.title: How MoEngage turned over 400 APIs into agent tools with AgentCore Gateway | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: MoEngage turned roughly 400 private REST APIs across 7 AWS Regions into permission-scoped agent tools with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway. No per-service MCP servers, no public endpoints, and no 400-tool context bloat. See how OpenAPI specs, Cedar policies, and managed Amazon VPC Lattice egress made it work.
articles.titleEn: How MoEngage turned over 400 APIs into agent tools with AgentCore Gateway | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The approach saved MoEngage an estimated six months of platform engineering effort, and onboarding a new API now takes hours instead of days.
When engineering teams start building AI agents, the capabilities those agents need usually already exist as internal APIs.
In this post, we walk through how MoEngage used AgentCore Gateway, a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, to turn those private APIs into permission-scoped agent tools.

articles.title: Lend and borrow resources across teams with AWS Batch’s quota management for SageMaker Training jobs | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: AWS Batch quota management is a new scheduling capability you can use to divide GPU capacity into quota shares per team or project, automatically lend idle capacity across shares, and use preemption to run your highest-priority SageMaker Training jobs first, all without manual coordination.
articles.titleEn: Lend and borrow resources across teams with AWS Batch’s quota management for SageMaker Training jobs | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: If jobs arrive in a quota share that is at or above its capacity limit, AWS Batch checks whether there’s available capacity to borrow from another quota share.

These strategies determine whether idle compute is reserved until jobs arrive ( RESERVE ), lent to other quota shares that have work available ( LEND ), or both lent when idle and borrowed when the share has work that might benefit ( LEND_AND_BORROW ).

Complete the setup required to install a compatible version of the SageMaker Python SDK: Using the new quota management capabilities requires creating a Scheduling Policy that contains a quotaSharePolicy , a Service Environment that specifies its capacity limits in terms of specific instances, and a SageMaker Training job queue that is connected to both.

summaryLines: 작업이 해당 용량 한도 이상인 할당량 공유에 도달하면 AWS Batch는 다른 할당량 공유에서 빌릴 수 있는 용량이 있는지 확인함
이러한 전략은 작업이 도착할 때까지 유휴 컴퓨팅을 예약할지( RESERVE ), 사용 가능한 작업이 있는 다른 할당량 공유에 빌려줄지( LEND ), 유휴 상태일 때 빌려주고 공유에 이익이 될 수 있는 작업이 있을 때 차용할지( LEND_AND_BORROW ) 여부를 결정함
SageMaker Python SDK의 호환 가능한 버전을 설치하는 데 필요한 설정을 완료함 · 새로운 할당량 관리 기능을 사용하려면 quotaSharePolicy 를 포함하는 일정 정책, 특정 인스턴스에 대한 용량 제한을 지정하는 서비스 환경, 그리고 두 가지 모두에 연결된 SageMaker 훈련 작업 대기열을 생성해야 함

articles.descEn: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.
articles.titleEn: Expanding our partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government
summaryLinesEn: Partnerships Apr 24, 2026 Anthropic and NEC collaborate to build Japan’s largest AI engineering workforce We are expanding our partnership with the General Services Administration (GSA) through a new agreement that gives government partners a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government, and the Claude API.

articles.descEn: A blog post covering tips and tricks that have proven effective for using Claude Code across various codebases, languages, and environments.
articles.titleEn: Claude Code Best Practices
summaryLinesEn: Developed as a research project, Claude Code gives Anthropic engineers and researchers a more native way to integrate Claude into their coding workflows.
Many engineers use # frequently to document commands, files, and style guidelines while coding, then include CLAUDE.md changes in commits so team members benefit as well.

As a client, it can connect to any number of MCP servers to access their tools in three ways: In project config (available when running Claude Code in that directory) In a checked-in .mcp.json file (available to anyone working in your codebase).

articles.title: Five Rules for Using AI Without Creating Work Slop
articles.descEn: Stop creating AI-generated "slop." Learn five proven rules for using AI to create high-quality content that actually works—from treating prompts as living documents to keeping human creativity at the center. Transform a single asset into a multi-channel campaign in minutes without sacrificing quality or trust.
articles.titleEn: Five Rules for Using AI Without Creating Work Slop
summaryLinesEn: With AI tools, I — a person who can’t draw a stick figure — can whip up illustrations, videos, slide decks, and some theme music to go with them at the push of a button.
Use of the AI in the workplace is growing rapidly , but simply making loads more content won’t help your team increase productivity or make an impact if it’s all kind of … blah.
They let you refine your instructions iteratively, add variables for repeatability, easily share improvements with colleagues, and build something that gets better every time you use it.

articles.title: Build a repeatable PHP-to-Java migration engine with Kiro | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Turn a PHP-to-Java migration from a one-time leap of faith into a measurable, repeatable process with Kiro. This post walks through a reusable engine: a mechanical discovery scanner and an eight-phase, parity-first workflow that treats the original PHP application as the specification and verifies the Java port with a parity harness.
articles.titleEn: Build a repeatable PHP-to-Java migration engine with Kiro | Amazon Web Services

articles.title: Building intent-driven UI testing with Amazon Nova Act | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Epsilon's Agentic Platform team delivers UI testing as a managed, multi-tenant service built on Amazon Nova Act and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Browser Tool. Tests are written in plain English and run on browsers managed by AWS, giving every product team resilient, intent-driven testing with zero per-team infrastructure overhead.
articles.titleEn: Building intent-driven UI testing with Amazon Nova Act | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: In this post, we walk through Epsilon’s architecture for delivering UI testing as a managed platform service, show the core Nova Act and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Browser Tool integration code, highlight a concrete 18-step test workflow, and share best practices and measured results.
With hundreds of millions of consumer profiles and thousands of brand relationships, Epsilon needed UI testing that could keep pace with rapid application changes.

Test jobs are queued in Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) and picked up by the Runner Service running on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS), which contains the Nova Act engine and a headless Chromium browser.

localization.title: Amazon Nova Act를 사용하여 의도 기반 UI 테스트 구축 | 아마존 웹 서비스
summaryLines: 이 게시물에서는 UI 테스트를 관리형 플랫폼 서비스로 제공하기 위한 Epsilon의 아키텍처를 살펴보고, 핵심 Nova Act 및 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 브라우저 도구 통합 코드를 보여주고, 구체적인 18단계 테스트 워크플로를 강조하고, 모범 사례와 측정된 결과를 공유함
수억 개의 소비자 프로필과 수천 개의 브랜드 관계를 갖춘 Epsilon에는 빠른 애플리케이션 변화에 보조를 맞출 수 있는 UI 테스트가 필요함
테스트 작업은 Amazon Simple Queue Service(Amazon SQS)의 대기열에 추가되고 Nova Act 엔진과 헤드리스 Chromium 브라우저가 포함된 Amazon Elastic Container Service(Amazon ECS)에서 실행되는 Runner Service에 의해 선택됨

articles.title: From Complexity to Clarity
articles.descEn: How SCAN Health Plan uses WRITER’s secure generative AI to simplify healthcare complexity, empower associates, and deliver personalized, empathetic member communications.
articles.titleEn: From Complexity to Clarity
summaryLinesEn: Founded by a group of seniors who believed they could build a better, more compassionate way to navigate healthcare for their peers, this not-for-profit Medicare Advantage plan has been dedicated to one thing for nearly 50 years: keeping seniors healthy and independent.

This renewed focus on relationship-building and proactive member support is expected to not only improve employee satisfaction and retention but also to create a ripple effect that enhances the member experience.
This “swivel chair” effect, as Corinne Stroum describes it, had employees jumping between up to 14 different systems to answer a single member query.

articles.title: New at WRITER: Playbooks built for quality, cost efficiency, and control
articles.descEn: Discover how WRITER's upgraded playbooks combine modular steps, built-in testing, and bulk runs to scale complex work with quality and control.
articles.titleEn: New at WRITER: Playbooks built for quality, cost efficiency, and control
summaryLinesEn: Users can now break playbooks down into modular steps, chain multiple playbooks together, test and optimize playbooks before rollout, and run them in bulk.
Today, we’re rolling out an upgraded playbooks experience to help teams scale more complex, end-to-end processes with higher quality, greater cost efficiency, and more control.
As teams automate more work, they often end up with multiple playbooks that support different parts of the same process.
