articles.title: Announcing General Availability of Real-Time Mode for Spark Declarative Pipelines on Databricks | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Announcing General Availability of Real-Time Mode (RTM) on Spark Declarative Pipelines (SDP), delivering end-to-end processing latencies in the millisecond range for operational streaming workloads.
articles.titleEn: Announcing General Availability of Real-Time Mode for Spark Declarative Pipelines on Databricks | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: We benchmarked RTM against Apache Flink on actual customer workloads performing feature computation, and RTM is up to 92% faster than specialized engines like Flink.
We introduced Real-Time Mode (RTM) last year which enabled customers to build low-latency, operational use cases.
This was a game changer because it allowed customers to process streaming data in milliseconds, up to 100x faster than traditional micro-batch architecture.

articles.title: Build, test and optimize faster: Arm and GitHub accelerate agentic AI development
articles.descEn: See how native Arm development with GitHub Copilot helps developers test on the target architecture, reduce handoffs, and optimize software using real Arm measurements.
articles.titleEn: Build, test and optimize faster: Arm and GitHub accelerate agentic AI development
summaryLinesEn: GitHub Copilot CLI provides AI-assisted development on native Arm compute, enabling developers to direct agents to make code changes, execute project commands, and investigate test failures in the target environment.

Develop and iterate natively: Use GitHub Copilot CLI to edit code, build, test, and investigate failures directly within that Arm-native environment, reducing the need to switch between architectures during development.
Arm Total Design for Physical AI brings silicon, software, safety, security, validation, and more into one collaborative ecosystem to help build, validate, and scale full-stack solutions on Arm.

articles.titleEn: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
summaryLinesEn: Explore the projects below to see frontier AI models such as GPT-6 Astra at work, and check back for new examples from NVIDIA teams and developers across the ecosystem.
Omniverse libraries provide GPU-accelerated physics, rendering and sensor simulation capabilities.

Turn Robot Computer-Aided Design Into a SimReady Asset 🔗 Before testing whether a robot can pick up and move a box, developers need a simulation model with joints that move correctly and with grippers that can hold the object.

summaryLinesEn: Neural graphics are changing what’s possible, using AI-based techniques to reduce traditional rendering workloads and free up graphics performance, so developers can devote more of their graphics budget to lighting, shadows, motion, and more cinematic environments.
Arm Total Design for Physical AI brings silicon, software, safety, security, validation, and more into one collaborative ecosystem to help build, validate, and scale full-stack solutions on Arm.

Earlier this year, Arm and Sumo demonstrated this potential with Neural Dawn , which is the first game showcasing Arm Neural Technology and Unreal Engine MegaLights , bringing cinematic lighting, ray tracing, and neural graphics into a complete mobile gaming experience.

articles.descEn: Moby summary of T-Mobile US, Inc.'s Q3 2026 earnings call
articles.titleEn: T-Mobile US, Inc. Q3 2026 Earnings Call Summary
summaryLinesEn: Remains on track to reach 15 million 5G broadband customers and 3 million to 4 million fiber customers by 2030, utilizing a fallow capacity model for fixed wireless growth.
Accelerated digital transformation through the T-Life app, which reached 32 million monthly active users and now facilitates over 80% of device upgrades and 50% of phone line activations.
Raised full-year 2026 guidance for postpaid ARPA growth to approximately 3.5%, driven by continued adoption of premium rate plans and successful rate plan modernization initiatives.

Raised full-year 2026 guidance for postpaid ARPA growth to approximately 3.5%, driven by continued adoption of premium rate plans and successful rate plan modernization initiatives.

summaryLinesEn: In the past year, NBIS stock has gained 46.9% while IREN declined 50.4%.
The company is accelerating its transition from Bitcoin mining to AI cloud services, supported by multiyear customer contracts and an expanding data center portfolio.

articles.title: Alphabet earnings miss reflects first real sign that AI is taking a bite out of search
articles.descEn: Wall Street hammered Alphabet for an earnings miss that included weaker-than-expected revenue out of the company's core business.
articles.titleEn: Alphabet earnings miss reflects first real sign that AI is taking a bite out of search
summaryLinesEn: In Microsoft's quarterly earnings report , which also landed after the bell Wednesday, the software maker said Azure revenue increased 48% from a year earlier to $33.2 billion.
While search remains a massive business, early signs of a shift are appearing.
Alphabet executives said foreign exchange was the biggest factor behind the deceleration in search revenue in the period, and said the currency impact would be even greater in the fourth quarter.

articles.title: AI buildout hits snag as Google and Microsoft put off raising capex forecasts
articles.descEn: Microsoft and Alphabet both reported capital expenditures that fell short of estimates, adding to concern over the cost of the AI buildout.
articles.titleEn: AI buildout hits snag as Google and Microsoft put off raising capex forecasts
summaryLinesEn: In Meta's earnings report last week, the company said it expects full-year capex of $135 billion to $145 billion, raising the bottom of the range from $130 billion.
Microsoft's Hood said Wednesday that she sees capital spending accelerating in the first half of 2027 thanks to higher component costs and the delayed deliveries.

Despite the third-quarter capex shortfall, investors cheered Microsoft's report on Wednesday as the company beat earnings and revenue estimates, driven by 48% sales growth in its Azure cloud business.
articles.summary:
In Meta's earnings report last week, the company said it expects full-year capex of $135 billion to $145 billion, raising the bottom of the range from $130 billion.
Microsoft's Hood said Wednesday that she sees capital spending accelerating in the first half of 2027 thanks to higher component costs and the delayed deliveries.
Despite the third-quarter capex shortfall, investors cheered Microsoft's report on Wednesday as the company beat earnings and revenue estimates, driven by 48% sales growth in its Azure cloud business.

articles.title: VikingCloud Launches AI Governance Services to Help Brands Find, Assess, and Control Their AI
articles.descEn: Only 4% of large multi-location brands require a corporate security review before locations adopt AI tools, according to recent VikingCloud research. VikingCloud, a cybersecurity and compliance company trusted by 4+ million business locations worldwide, today launched AI Governance Services, a new set of compliance and risk assessments that find the AI tools in use across a business, show where security controls fall short, and deliver a remediation plan to close the gaps.
articles.titleEn: VikingCloud Launches AI Governance Services to Help Brands Find, Assess, and Control Their AI
summaryLinesEn: AI Governance Services extend VikingCloud's assessor practice to AI, bringing the same rigor its global network of assessors has applied to leading brands' security and compliance controls for more than 20 years.

VikingCloud, a cybersecurity and compliance company trusted by 4+ million business locations worldwide, today launched AI Governance Services , a new set of compliance and risk assessments that find the AI tools in use across a business, show where security controls fall short, and deliver a remediation plan to close the gaps.

articles.title: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
articles.descEn: The frontier lab is lifting the curtain on how users spend money on its models ahead of a planned IPO.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
summaryLinesEn: The company recorded an operating profit in the second quarter, and 900% net revenue retention — that is, spending from the same customers in Q3 2025 grew nine times in Q3 2026.
More importantly, spending on those tools has grown 10x since the beginning of the year, with their cost now equal to about 2% of total engineering cost.
This is a clear attempt to demonstrate the return on investment of Anthropic’s tools and to show customers how to improve it — a major concern among large customers.

articles.title: Adam Mosseri says negativity around AI is ‘going to get worse’
articles.descEn: Adam Mosseri said in an interview that he expects frustration and anger toward AI to continue getting worse, and not just in creative industries.
articles.titleEn: Adam Mosseri says negativity around AI is ‘going to get worse’
summaryLinesEn: Follow Follow See All AI The Instagram boss said that worries about AI come down to ‘a fear of being left behind in some way.’
They’re concerned about job displacement, having AI displace whatever it is they do, if you’re a content creator or an engineer or a mathematician.
Mosseri said Instagram is “now starting to require AI accounts to label themselves, because we think it’s important that people know if what they’re looking at is real or not real.”

articles.title: Creating AI value with enterprise context
articles.descEn: Across a business, any number of AI platforms, systems, and tools may be at work simultaneously—for example, AI-powered customer platforms, conversational assistants, and workflow and process automation tools. Each one is sophisticated, advanced, and quick to respond. But, when set to work, the outcomes and actions that emerge may be wrong, confused, or lacking a…
articles.titleEn: Creating AI value with enterprise context
summaryLinesEn: Companies are mostly still piloting AI use cases (according to 38% of respondents) or using it to assist employees’ work with tools like co-pilots or chat assistants (35%).
It translates enterprise intelligence into governed, machine-usable context for AI agents or models and helps knowledge compound.

The largest percentage of respondents (40%) say they are seeing moderate gains in specific tasks or teams, while 21% report meaningful gains, leaving 23% that are seeing minimal returns or none at all.

articles.titleEn: Google Deepmind releases Gemini 4 Carbon just two weeks after Argon with gains across the board
summaryLinesEn: Ad On Gray Swan's indirect prompt injection benchmark, Carbon pushed the attack success rate from 0.7 percent with Argon down to 0.0 percent, blocking every tested manipulation attempt according to Google.

Ad The evaluation platform Vals AI puts Carbon in second place at 70.36 percent accuracy, behind Claude Sonnet 5.5 (70.85 percent) and ahead of Claude Opus 5.5 (70.18 percent) and Argon in fourth (69.24 percent), all at lower cost.

Gemini 4 Carbon launches at the same introductory price as Argon: $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, with cached input tokens getting a 95 percent discount off the regular input price.

sourceContent.headline: Google Deepmind releases Gemini 4 Carbon just two weeks after Argon with gains across the board
sourceContent.description: Just two weeks after Gemini 4 Argon, Google DeepMind is releasing Gemini 4 Carbon, which tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 with 59 points. Google says the model is built for extended agent workflows and the full cyber defense lifecycle. Because of those advanced security capabilities, access is limited to selected security experts at first.

articles.title: Chrome's AI-powered Autofill can now dig through your Gmail to fill out forms
articles.descEn: The autofill update lets Chrome pull flight confirmations, tracking info, order details, and other information from your inbox, with your permission.
articles.titleEn: Chrome's AI-powered Autofill can now dig through your Gmail to fill out forms
summaryLinesEn: On Wednesday, the company said that Chrome will get an advanced version of autofill that will help users fill out online forms with suggestions pulled from their Gmail.

That means Chrome could suggest things you might need to know, like a flight confirmation number, membership ID, tracking information, order number, address, phone number, or credit card number by referencing your email.
As with other Personalized Intelligence features, users can decide whether or not to enable enhanced autofill from their Chrome settings.

localization.title: 이제 Chrome의 AI 기반 자동완성이 Gmail을 탐색하여 양식을 작성할 수 있음
summaryLines: 수요일에 회사는 Chrome에 사용자가 Gmail에서 가져온 제안 사항을 사용하여 온라인 양식을 작성하는 데 도움이 되는 고급 버전의 자동 완성을 제공할 것이라고 밝힘
즉, Chrome에서는 이메일을 참조하여 항공편 확인 번호, 멤버십 ID, 추적 정보, 주문 번호, 주소, 전화번호, 신용카드 번호 등 귀하가 알아야 할 정보를 제안할 수 있음
다른 개인화된 지능 기능과 마찬가지로 사용자는 Chrome 설정에서 향상된 자동 완성을 활성화할지 여부를 결정할 수 있음

articles.title: Pairing industrial AI autonomy and human control
articles.descEn: Living digital twins are helping industrial plants run more like living systems, and setting the stage for industries that work in sync.
articles.titleEn: Pairing industrial AI autonomy and human control
summaryLinesEn: For their part, manufacturers are eager for this chapter: In a 2026 Manufacturing Leadership Council survey of manufacturers (opens in new tab) , 66% said they are using or plan to use agentic AI in their operations, and 40% expect some degree of factory autonomy by 2030.
Amid today’s realities of turbulent geopolitics and shifting regulatory demands, such resilience will be “an absolute necessity,” adds McGreevy.

Manufacturers are accelerating toward agentic AI and greater factory autonomy Source: MIT Technology Review Insights with data from Manufacturing Leadership Council (opens in new tab) , 2026 “There is a lot more refinement to be done, a lot more proof points, testing, and validation needed,” McGreevy says about the ongoing process of making AI autonomous.

articles.title: Should AI Decide Your Court Case? This Judge Says Yes
articles.descEn: One of England’s top judges, Geoffrey Vos, believes that AI could adjudicate plenty of civil cases. The question, he says, is where the line should be drawn.
articles.titleEn: Should AI Decide Your Court Case? This Judge Says Yes
summaryLinesEn: We see a 10 percent rise in the number of county court cases started every year—and it looks as if this may increase.
We moved rapidly into word processors, faxes, and eventually computers.
Multiple lawyers have been caught citing case law hallucinated by AI, and in a first for the UK, somebody recently lost their license to practice in part because they misused the technology.

articles.title: Advisory services reshape accounting education at Intuit - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Advisory services are becoming central to accounting as AI automates routine work, and Intuit Inc. is building a curriculum to prepare students.
articles.titleEn: Advisory services reshape accounting education at Intuit - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Accounting firms spend time retraining new hires, while fewer students are choosing the major out of fear that AI will take the jobs they expected to do, according to David Zasada (pictured), vice president of education and corporate engagement at Intuit.
That shift leaves colleges racing to prepare graduates for a job that looks very different from the one in the textbooks.
“They need to really hit the ground running and provide more value in client advisory services roles, and that is a segment of an accounting firm’s business that’s really on the rise,” Zasada said.

localization.title: Intuit의 회계 교육을 재구성하는 자문 서비스 - SiliconANGLE
summaryLines: Intuit의 교육 및 기업 참여 담당 부사장인 David Zasada(사진)에 따르면 회계 회사는 신입 사원을 재교육하는 데 시간을 소비하는 반면, AI가 예상한 업무를 대신할 것이라는 두려움 때문에 전공을 선택하는 학생이 줄어들고 있다고 함
이러한 변화로 인해 대학은 교과서에 나오는 직업과 매우 다른 직업을 위해 졸업생을 준비시키기 위해 경쟁하게 됨
Zasada는 "그들은 실제로 사업을 시작하고 고객 자문 서비스 역할에 더 많은 가치를 제공해야 하며 이는 실제로 성장하고 있는 회계 회사 비즈니스의 한 부분입니다"라고 말함

articles.titleEn: Jedify formally launches Data Agents for building AI analysts in plain language - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Data Agents takes on a longstanding limit of business intelligence software, where analysts have to build dashboards ahead of time around the questions they expect people to ask.
In Jedify’s telling, those tools end up guessing at what a business means from its raw tables and schemas.
Jedify is a venture capital-backed startup that has raised more than $33 million, including a $24 million Series A round led by Norwest in June .

articles.title: AI Emergency Alerts Are Coming. Humans Might Not Be Ready
articles.descEn: Human beings struggle with emergency communication. Chatbots can help—if people take them seriously.
articles.titleEn: AI Emergency Alerts Are Coming. Humans Might Not Be Ready
summaryLinesEn: A seasoned emergency manager might be able to speed up their communication with the public by having a chatbot draft a series of alerts, but an inexperienced one rushing to create an urgent alert won’t know how to evaluate the output of a model like ChatGPT or Claude.
Emergency managers are the government officials who are in charge of disaster response and recovery.

“If you’ve only sent one [alert] in your life, and that was 15 years ago, and you need to remember all your training, and you’re thinking ‘Hey, there's a chemical plume coming my way, the phone's ringing, the radio's blaring, I need help,’ the AI is probably gonna do a better job than you are,” said Rob Dale, a former meteorologist who now runs the emergency management department in Ingham County, Michigan.

articles.title: AI agents hacked Anthropic, maker of arguably the most capable AI models for cyberdefense
articles.descEn: Cybersecurity startup Cathedral used AI agents to break into Anthropic's internal systems through third-party software as part of a bug bounty program. Anthropic confirmed access to sales, HR, and IT data but disputes how deep the breach went. The incident shows how vulnerable even leading AI labs are through their external software dependencies.
articles.titleEn: AI agents hacked Anthropic, maker of arguably the most capable AI models for cyberdefense
summaryLinesEn: Ad Anthropic confirmed that the researchers accessed a limited set of sales, human resources, and IT systems, including contact information for some customers and partners along with basic user account data.
AI agents are changing how cyberattacks work, and this breach shows how fast the shift is happening.
The incident shows a growing threat: AI agents can now probe corporate networks around the clock at minimal cost, and even Anthropic isn't safe.

articles.title: With AI writing the code, entrepreneurial thinking is now what counts most for newcomers at Anthropic
articles.descEn: Anthropic manager Felix Rieseberg says the classic coding interview is dead because Claude now solves small programming tasks better than job candidates do. He'd rather see prototypes that show taste, empathy, and principled thinking, since in his words, "hunger beats tenure." That sounds empowering, but it pushes the bar for newcomers toward entrepreneurial thinking and assumes a hustle mentality not everyone brings to the job.
articles.titleEn: With AI writing the code, entrepreneurial thinking is now what counts most for newcomers at Anthropic
summaryLinesEn: Most universities barely teach those skills, and companies have traditionally expected them from experienced product managers or founders.
Why newcomers spot the problems veterans stopped seeing Rieseberg argues that newcomers have a structural advantage because they notice problems that long-time employees accepted as givens years ago.
You had to work your way up a rigid hierarchy before management trusted you to actually build something.

articles.title: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model
articles.descEn: Nvidia just released a free speech-to-text model that can transcribe up to 40 languages, but it only works on recordings, not live audio, so it’s a big step for meeting and medical transcription tools while still leaving real-time use to rivals like ElevenLabs.
articles.titleEn: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model
summaryLinesEn: Nvidia on Wednesday released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe , a free, open-weight model that transcribes audio in up to 40 languages.

Nvidia’s latest voice entry comes during a busy period of AI voice releases: Mistral shipped Voxtral 3 earlier this month; ElevenLabs launched Realtime for instant speech in voice agents; and Salesforce released Launa-Omni, its voice model.
Provides movers and shakers with the info they need to start their day.

articles.title: AI execs may be too out of touch to build for the general public
articles.descEn: Tech leaders are flaunting how out of touch they are when they brag about using AI to connect with their families.
articles.titleEn: AI execs may be too out of touch to build for the general public
summaryLinesEn: “The average American I think has, it’s fewer than three friends, three people they’d consider friends, and the average person has demand for meaningfully more, I think it’s like 15 friends,” Zuckerberg said last year on a podcast .

"She thought it was perfect."www.nytimes.com/2026/10/25/s… Perhaps Mayer drew so much backlash because we have repeatedly observed sheltered billionaires suggest that we outsource childrearing — one of life’s greatest tests of patience, humility, and kindness — to a computer that is incapable of understanding human emotion.

In an interview about her new app Dazzle, an AI assistant that learns from your camera roll, Mayer poses what she believes is an impressive flex for the product: it helped her come up with three bullet points about her ten-year-old daughter for a birthday presentation at school, describing her as “empathetic, creative, and an animal lover.”

summaryLines: 저커버그는 지난해 팟캐스트에서 "내가 생각하는 평균적인 미국인은 친구가 3명도 안 되는 것 같 · 친구라고 생각하는 사람은 3명이며, 평균적인 사람은 의미 있게 더 많은 친구를 요구함 · 내 생각엔 15명의 친구와 같다"고 말함
"그녀는 그것이 완벽하다고 생각함" · www.nytimes.com/2026/10/25/s… 아마도 메이어는 보호받는 억만장자들이 인간의 감정을 이해할 수 없는 컴퓨터에 자녀 양육(인내, 겸손, 친절에 대한 인생의 가장 큰 시험 중 하나)을 아웃소싱한다고 제안한 것을 반복적으로 관찰했기 때문에 그렇게 많은 반발을 받았을 것임

articles.title: Macmillan Staff Say the Publisher Threw a Party for a Workplace AI Assistant That Was Later Killed
articles.descEn: Workers tell WIRED that NOA—or “No Ordinary Assistant”—was unhelpful. Bestselling authors also say AI is ruining their relationships with Big Five publishers.
articles.titleEn: Macmillan Staff Say the Publisher Threw a Party for a Workplace AI Assistant That Was Later Killed
summaryLinesEn: Brandon Sanderson, for instance, publishes some of his fantasy novels through Tor Books, an imprint of Macmillan, but raised more than $15 million from his readers on Kickstarter to publish four books on his own in 2022.
In an email to staff, NOA was introduced as an AI chatbot developed by the German software company Chaptr, which is “backed” by Holtzbrinck, Macmillan’s parent company.
Ostensibly, this means NOA was a closed-loop enterprise tool that did not retain or share data for model training.

articles.title: Google opens Android development to third-party AI agents and unveils new Gemini APIs
articles.descEn: Google is opening up Android Studio to third-party AI agents. Through a new "Bring Your Own Agent" feature, the IDE now supports more than 40 coding agents, including Anthropic's Claude Agent and OpenAI's Codex. Google says new terminal tools also help agents finish UI tasks 77 percent faster while using up to three times fewer tokens. Android development is becoming agent-centric too.
articles.titleEn: Google opens Android development to third-party AI agents and unveils new Gemini APIs
summaryLinesEn: Google and hardware maker XREAL also unveiled the XREAL AURA, a $1,099 pair of smart glasses running Android XR that displays virtual workspaces and uses Gemini to analyze the real-world environment.

Ad New terminal tools and specialized skills cut token usage for coding agents Google expanded the Android CLI command-line tool for developers who run their agents in the terminal or in CI pipelines.
It evaluates language models on multi-day development projects based on functionality, time spent, and cost.

articles.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with a ‘significant leap’ in cybersecurity
articles.descEn: Google has launched Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier model that the company says offers “significant gains” in coding, agentic tasks, and cybersecurity.
articles.titleEn: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with a ‘significant leap’ in cybersecurity
summaryLinesEn: It will launch at the same competitive introductory price as Argon, at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens.
Google has released its latest frontier model, Gemini 4 Carbon, offering “significant gains” in coding, agentic tasks, and cybersecurity.
In an announcement on Wednesday , Google highlights Carbon’s top spot on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (v5.0) benchmark, with Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra trailing behind.

articles.title: I Put a Bunch of AI Agents in Charge of a Fantasy Soccer Team. They’re Not Better Than Humans—Yet
articles.descEn: To experiment with AI’s predictive skills, I let Codex loose on a fantasy team. It tried to bench Erling Haaland at first, but it soon learned the error of its ways.
articles.titleEn: I Put a Bunch of AI Agents in Charge of a Fantasy Soccer Team. They’re Not Better Than Humans—Yet
summaryLinesEn: I tried increasing the number of agents to more than 100, hoping this would make the system smarter still, but it didn’t change much besides running up my API bill.

According to Haifeng Xu , a computer scientist at the University of Chicago who studies the uses of AI in market situations, newer models may be even better at making predictions because they’re able to consume and analyze huge amounts of real-world information, and they’re able to orchestrate more complex systems for their guesses.

It’s one of a number of benchmarks designed to test AI’s future-gazing capabilities; another, Prediction Arena , from researchers at Harvard University and a company called Arcada Labs, recently gave frontier models $10,000 to wager on prediction markets over 57 days.

articles.title: Gemini 4 Carbon (high) - Intelligence, Performance & Price Analysis | Artificial Analysis
articles.descEn: Analysis of Google's Gemini 4 Carbon (High) and comparison to other AI models across key metrics including quality, price, performance (time per Intelligence Index task & time to first answer token), context window & more.
articles.titleEn: Gemini 4 Carbon (high) - Intelligence, Performance & Price Analysis | Artificial Analysis
summaryLinesEn: On average, it costs $7.76 per task to evaluate Gemini 4 Carbon (High) on the Intelligence Index.

The cost to run the evaluations in the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, calculated using the model's input, cache hit, cache write, reasoning, and answer token prices and the number of tokens used across evaluations (excluding repeats).
At 27.2 minutes per Intelligence Index task, Gemini 4 Carbon (High) is notably slow compared with the median of 12.7 minutes for comparable models (lower is better).

articles.title: Home Depot wants your AI agent to show some ID first
articles.descEn: Home Depot's chief information officer told Business Insider the retailer needs AI agents to self-identity and verify they're acting on your behalf.
articles.titleEn: Home Depot wants your AI agent to show some ID first
summaryLinesEn: She said the company was not granted access in the project's first wave, "despite our best efforts, and calling a lot of friends."

articles.title: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system
articles.descEn: In early results from our new life sciences research lab, Claude agents found an enzyme system whose function is still unknown.
articles.titleEn: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system
summaryLinesEn: After 21 hours spent searching this data by roughly 950 agents using 210 million tokens, one of the agents spotted something remarkable: a repeating pattern of DNA sequences that occurs next to the gene for an odd-looking RT.

Our research prior to joining Anthropic has helped to better understand the evolution and regulation of CRISPR systems, discover new enzymes for next-generation cell and gene therapies , and build tools for accelerating the identification of anomalies in DNA, such as human pathogenic variants.
We do research that involves only the lower levels of the biosafety risk level (BSL-1 and BSL-2) and we do not handle pathogens that can infect humans.

localization.title: 클로드가 새로운 효소 시스템을 발견하
summaryLines: 약 950명의 에이전트가 2억 1천만 개의 토큰을 사용하여 이 데이터를 검색한 후 21시간 동안 에이전트 중 한 명이 주목할만한 사실을 발견함 · 이상하게 보이는 RT의 유전자 옆에서 발생하는 DNA 서열의 반복 패턴이었음
Anthropic에 합류하기 전 우리의 연구는 CRISPR 시스템의 진화와 규제를 더 잘 이해하고, 차세대 세포 및 유전자 치료를 위한 새로운 효소를 발견하고, 인간 병원성 변종과 같은 DNA의 변칙적 식별을 가속화하기 위한 도구를 구축하는 데 도움이 됨
우리는 낮은 수준의 생물안전 위험 수준(BSL-1 및 BSL-2)만을 포함하는 연구를 수행하며 인간을 감염시킬 수 있는 병원체는 취급하지 않음

articles.title: Coding agents in the social sciences
articles.descEn: Results from a survey of 1,260 social scientists about AI and coding agent use.
articles.titleEn: Coding agents in the social sciences
summaryLinesEn: But Figure 4 shows that the most common use, for both coding agent users and others, is for coding up analysis of quantitative data: 97% of coding agent users and 77% of other AI users report using it to generate code.
The human sciences are shifting: for the first time, core research tasks can be handed off to machines.
These tools could accelerate science and make it more daring: fast research execution should mean cheap and plentiful discovery.

articles.title: Inside Retail Media on the Top Delivery Platforms
articles.descEn: Read how delivery platforms like instacart, grubhub uber eats and restaurant advertisers approached delivery retail media in 2026.
articles.titleEn: Inside Retail Media on the Top Delivery Platforms
summaryLinesEn: In 2026 YTD, Instacart accounted for nearly half (49%) of all delivery retail media impressions, up from 24% over the same period in 2024.
Retail partnerships expanded the delivery occasion even further, with DoorDash highlighting Urban Outfitters delivery and Instacart promoting access to Lowe’s.
CPG brands often positioned delivery as an easy solution for everyday and last-minute needs, like having Tums delivered by Uber Eats.

articles.title: Agentic AI for marketing teams: Use cases from content generation to campaign orchestration
articles.descEn: Discover how agentic AI solves marketing's speed vs. custom fit dilemma. Six real use cases show automated campaign orchestration in action.
articles.titleEn: Agentic AI for marketing teams: Use cases from content generation to campaign orchestration
summaryLinesEn: Agentic AI is the project manager and the team: You give it a strategic goal (e.g., “launch a campaign for our new feature”), and it both orchestrates the entire process AND executes the work — researching competitors, drafting multiple content assets, cross-referencing brand guidelines, and preparing everything for launch.
Meanwhile, your team just launched their third campaign of the week — complete with personalized email sequences, industry-specific landing pages, and sales enablement materials.

And while AI tools promise to solve these challenges, most marketing teams are drowning in a sea of disconnected point solutions, endless prompting sessions, and the constant fear of losing their brand integrity in the rush to keep up.As a result, marketing leaders get caught in an impossible bind — you need both speed AND custom fit.

articles.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2: Intelligent Multilingual Transcription You Can Prompt and Adapt
articles.descEn: A Blog post by NVIDIA on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2: Intelligent Multilingual Transcription You Can Prompt and Adapt
summaryLinesEn: NVIDIA models hold the top two spots on David AI’s multilingual diarization leaderboard : Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe posts the lowest overall diarization error rate (DER), 18.26% across 21 languages, followed by Nemotron 3 Diarization at 18.38%.

Granary v2’s multilingual data (available on Hugging Face and ModelScope ) and reusable curation pipeline, together with NeMo Speech fine-tuning tools , extend prompt-level control to training: developers can define the written form they need and adapt the model to the speech their applications encounter.
On AA-AgentTalk, the held-out voice-agent speech set that makes up 50% of the AA-WER index, Transcribe scores 1.8% WER, versus 2.3% for the next-best open-weight model.

summaryLines: NVIDIA 모델은 David AI의 다국어 분할 리더보드에서 상위 2개 자리를 차지함 · Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe는 21개 언어에서 18.26%로 가장 낮은 전체 분할 오류율(DER)을 기록했고, Nemotron 3 Diarization은 18.38%로 그 뒤를 이었음
Granary v2의 다국어 데이터(Hugging Face 및 ModelScope에서 사용 가능) 및 재사용 가능한 큐레이션 파이프라인은 NeMo Speech 미세 조정 도구와 함께 교육에 대한 프롬프트 수준 제어를 확장함 · 개발자는 필요한 서면 형식을 정의하고 애플리케이션에서 접하는 음성에 모델을 적용할 수 있음
AA-WER 지수의 50%를 구성하는 보류 음성 에이전트 음성 세트인 AA-AgentTalk에서 Transcribe는 1.8%의 WER 점수를 얻은 반면 차선책 개방형 가중치 모델의 경우 2.3%를 기록함

articles.title: Chrome’s enhanced autofill helps you fill out forms with suggestions pulled from Gmail.
articles.descEn: Chrome now pulls flight bookings and order numbers from Gmail to autofill forms. See how Gemini in Chrome simplifies your data entry today.
articles.titleEn: Chrome’s enhanced autofill helps you fill out forms with suggestions pulled from Gmail.
summaryLinesEn: Filling out online forms can be tedious, especially when you have to switch between tabs or search through your inbox to track down information.
Using Gemini with Personal Intelligence, it can surface details like order numbers, tracking information, and flight bookings, right when you need them.
Starting today, Chrome’s enhanced autofill feature can automatically suggest information pulled directly from Gmail as you fill out online forms.

articles.descEn: Be
articles.titleEn: Voice Agents are here. Context turns them into real customer value. | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: That same real-time decision making lets a voice agent switch languages, hand a caller to a person at the right moment, or give your most valuable customers the experience they expect.
People who moved from storefronts to websites to apps now expect to simply talk to the companies they buy from, and the same shift is reaching suppliers, drivers, and field teams.
Three other drivers are already on hold, and every minute he waits puts the next delivery at risk.

articles.title: Accelerating software delivery with agentic QA automation using Amazon Nova Act – Part 3 | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: As QA test automation spreads across an organization, organizing tests and controlling who owns them becomes the real work. Part 3 of the QA Studio series on Amazon Nova Act adds applications that organize tests and report health metrics, plus team-based user management that controls who can see and change what.
articles.titleEn: Accelerating software delivery with agentic QA automation using Amazon Nova Act – Part 3 | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: As quality assurance (QA) automation adoption grows inside an organization, a new problem appears that has nothing to do with writing tests.
In the first post , we introduced QA Studio, a reference solution built with Amazon Nova Act .
Because roles are cumulative, a Team Lead has everything an Editor has, and so on down to Viewer.

articles.title: Distributed training with Ray Train DLCs and EFA on EKS | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: The Ray Train Deep Learning Container ships the full CUDA-through-EFA stack, so you build no image. This post walks through a reproducible sample that fine-tunes Qwen2.5-1.5B with PyTorch FSDP across eight GPUs on two EFA-enabled g6.12xlarge instances on Amazon EKS, using the container exactly as published.
articles.titleEn: Distributed training with Ray Train DLCs and EFA on EKS | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Budget: about $9.50 an hour while the GPU instances are up, covering both instances, the EKS control plane and the NAT Gateway.
Qwen2.5-1.5B in bfloat16 needs about 12 GB for those four tensors.
Building that image and rebuilding it each time one of those pieces moves is a project of its own, and it has nothing to do with the model you set out to train.

articles.descEn: Google's Ads Decoded podcast tells you how to make smarter marketing decisions using the latest data on how consumers search.
articles.titleEn: Adapt your ad strategy to meet the way people search today.
summaryLinesEn: In this episode of Ads Decoded, Google Ads Product Liaison Ginny Marvin sits down with Shivani Mohan, Vice President of Data Science and UXR for Search.
Shivani and her teams study how billions of users are searching and explore how user habits are shifting with the introduction of AI Overviews and AI Mode.
Tune in for behind-the-scenes insights into her team's research, the modern search experience, and what long-form query trends mean for businesses today.

articles.title: AI for Science expands to foundations and institutions
articles.descEn: We’re highlighting 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and research groups from around the world that we’ve partnered with in an expansion of our AI for Science program.
articles.titleEn: AI for Science expands to foundations and institutions
summaryLinesEn: We started the AI for Science program in May 2025 with the belief that AI could significantly speed up scientific progress.

(Over the last few months, we’ve also launched our discounted Team plan for scientists and have supported hundreds of projects across biology, medicine, physics, chemistry, climate science, and mathematics.)

This $9 billion federal agency established by Congress in 1950 promotes the progress of science, advances national health and defense, and funds competitive research and education, accounting for about 25% of federal support for basic research at US colleges and universities.

summaryLines: 우리는 AI가 과학 발전을 크게 가속화할 수 있다는 믿음으로 2025년 5월 과학용 AI 프로그램을 시작함
(지난 몇 달 동안 우리는 과학자들을 위한 할인된 팀 플랜도 출시했으며 생물학, 의학, 물리학, 화학, 기후 과학 및 수학 전반에 걸쳐 수백 개의 프로젝트를 지원했습니다.)

articles.descEn: Discover how Arm’s Drive the Future 2026 event inspired students to explore AI and STEM careers through hands-on learning and mentorship.
articles.titleEn: Changing course: How Drive the Future helped students find their own path to success
summaryLinesEn: Drive the Future brought that commitment to life by connecting real-world applications of AI and advanced computing with perspectives from industry professionals who have faced their share of challenges.

Building on last year’s Drive the Future event , Arm, Aston Martin Aramco Formula One® Team, and Texas State Technical College expanded this year’s program to give students hands-on engineering experience, access to industry role models, and a clearer view of the many pathways into STEM.
“We’re going to need to continue to innovate forward into the future with new technologies and, of course, many brilliant minds.

글로벌 사기율 및 사기 손실 증가, AI 및 ML 구현, 실시간 데이터 분석 및 패턴 인식, 결제 및 은행 업무에 대한 영향 강조, 사기 탐지 및 예방 플랫폼이 은행 업무 방식을 어떻게 개선할 수 있는지 등 사기 퇴치를 위한 금융 사기 활동 탐지 및 예방 솔루션의 주요 동인 및 이점

articles.title: CIO Executive Council Resources
articles.titleEn: CIO Executive Council Resources
summaryLinesEn: This IDC Survey Spotlight, prepared by Gina Smith , PhD, Senior Research Director, IT Skills for Digital Business, examines data from IDC’s 2026 Future Enterprise Resiliency and Spending Survey to explore how organizations are grappling with IT skills validation across four key regions: North America, Asia Pacific, Western Europe, and the Middle East and North Africa.
As AI becomes integral to enterprise operations, CIOs are shifting focus from rapid deployment to engineering sustainable AI economics.

The survey highlights that leadership perspectives on modernization priorities, business drivers, obstacles, IT budget allocation, decision criteria, data architecture maturity, data quality, and the data-related initiatives organizations are prioritizing to enable AI use cases over the next 12–18 months.

localization.title: CIO 집행위원회 리소스
summaryLines: 디지털 비즈니스를 위한 IT 기술 수석 연구 이사인 Gina Smith 박사가 준비한 이 IDC 설문 조사 스포트라이트는 IDC의 2026년 미래 기업 탄력성 및 지출 설문 조사의 데이터를 검토하여 조직이 북미, 아시아 태평양, 서유럽, 중동 및 북아프리카의 4개 주요 지역에서 IT 기술 검증과 어떻게 씨름하고 있는지 살펴봄
AI가 기업 운영에 필수적인 요소가 되면서 CIO는 신속한 배포에서 지속 가능한 AI 경제성 엔지니어링으로 초점을 옮기고 있음
설문조사에서는 조직이 향후 12~18개월 동안 AI 사용 사례를 활성화하기 위해 우선순위를 정하는 현대화 우선 순위, 비즈니스 동인, 장애물, IT 예산 할당, 결정 기준, 데이터 아키텍처 성숙도, 데이터 품질 및 데이터 관련 이니셔티브에 대한 리더십 관점을 강조함
